PUBLIC_COMPANY - Có là CTĐC ( PUBLIC_COMPANY  = 1). Nếu là công ty đại chúng thì lấy ngành ở IDS có mã là 07000
CASE
    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(IDS.NNKD), '') IS NOT NULL
        THEN IDS.NNKD
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM SC_FIRM_INFO sc
        WHERE 1=1
        AND UPPER(TRIM(sc.SECURITIES_CODE))
              = UPPER(TRIM(x.Ma_ck))
          AND TRIM(CAST(sc.PUBLIC_COMPANY AS STRING))
              = :Public_company_yes
    )
        THEN (select IDS.NNKD from IDS where IDS.INDUSTRY_CD = '07000')
    ELSE NULL
END AS ten_nganh

column3: Khối lượng mở của phái sinh
column4:
Left join lại với Phái sinh On o.report_date = s.tradingdate AND o.contract_code = s.symbol
SQL tham khảo: 
-- Khối lượng mở (Phái sinh)
SELECT 
    o.report_date,
        o.contract_code,
        s.symbol
    o.open_interest_volume AS open_interest_volume
  FROM uat_vsdc_stg.end_of_day_open_interest o
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol, tradingdate ORDER BY tradingtime DESC, sequence desc) AS rn
        , s.*
    FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor s
        And s.floorcode in ( '02','04','03')
        and s.stocktype = '4'
    --WHERE tradingdate = '2025-05-05'
) s ON o.report_date = s.tradingdate AND o.contract_code = s.symbol And rn = 1 --- Join ngược lại với logic của phái sinh

    SUM(t.[Execution - Volume])     AS tong_kl_khop
FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
WHERE t.[Trade Date] = :ngay_gd
and Market ID in ('UPX','STX','STK')
 GROUP BY symbol
UNION ALL

SELECT
    SUM(t.[Trade quantity])         AS tong_kl_khop

and Market ID in ('UPX','STX','STK')
 GROUP BY symbol

column18:
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        statement_cd,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) AS statement_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    cd.company_profile_id,
                    cd.report_year,
                    cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                    END,
                    cd.submission_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f
            ON f.id = cd.form_id
           AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
          AND cd.submission_date <= ts.den_ngay
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
              JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf
                  ON vf.id = vr.form_id
                 AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= ts.den_ngay
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Doanh thu theo từng kỳ BCTC */
Doanh_thu AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        doanh_thu,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            cp.equity_ticker,
            cdc.report_year,
            cdc.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS doanh_thu,
            cdc.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '10')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '03')
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)

SELECT

    sub.ngay_gd,
    SUM(sub.kl_gd)          AS tong_kl_gd,
    SUM(sub.gt_gd)          AS tong_gt_gd
FROM (
    SELECT
        idx.indexCode,
        t.[Trade Date]                          AS ngay_gd,
        t.[Execution - Volume]                  AS kl_gd,
        t.[Execution - Value]                   AS gt_gd
    FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
    JOIN JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
        ON  t.Symbol        = idx.symbol
        AND t.[Trade Date]  = idx.tradingdate
        AND idx.indexCode   = :ma_chi_so
    WHERE t.[Trade Date]    = :ngay_gd
      AND t.[Market ID]     = 'STO'             

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        idx.indexCode,
        t.[Trade date]                          AS ngay_gd,
        t.[Trade quantity]                      AS kl_gd,
        CAST(t.[Trade price]  AS NUMERIC)
      * CAST(t.[Trade quantity] AS NUMERIC)     AS gt_gd
    FROM Trade_HNX t
    JOIN JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
        ON  t.[Issue Code]  = idx.symbol
        AND t.[Trade date]  = idx.tradingdate
        AND idx.indexCode   = :ma_chi_so
    WHERE t.[Trade date]    = :ngay_gd
      AND t.[Market ID]     = 'STX'             -- Cổ phiếu HNX niêm yết, loại BDX/HCX/DVX

    UNION ALL

    -- UPCOM: UpcomIndex
    SELECT
        idx.indexCode,
        t.[Trade date]                          AS ngay_gd,
        t.[Trade quantity]                      AS kl_gd,
        CAST(t.[Trade price]  AS NUMERIC)
      * CAST(t.[Trade quantity] AS NUMERIC)     AS gt_gd
    FROM Trade_HNX t
    JOIN JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
        ON  t.[Issue Code]  = idx.symbol
        AND t.[Trade date]  = idx.tradingdate
        AND idx.indexCode   = :ma_chi_so
    WHERE t.[Trade date]    = :ngay_gd
      AND t.[Market ID]     = 'UPX'             -- UPCOM, loại BDX/HCX/DVX

) sub
GROUP BY sub.indexCode, sub.ngay_gd;

Select 
        INDEXCODE
        --,SYMBOL
        ,SUM (tong_kl)
        ,SUM (tong_gt)
        ,SUM (tong_kl_tt)
        ,SUM (tong_gt_tt)
        ,SUM (kl_nn_mua) - SUM (kl_nn_ban) kl_nn_rong
        ,SUM (gt_nn_mua) - SUM (gt_nn_ban) gt_nn_rong
        from 
        (
            SELECT
                idx.INDEXCODE  AS INDEXCODE,
                t.ISSUE_CODE SYMBOL,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                         THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS tong_kl,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                         THEN CAST(t.TRADE_PRICE AS NUMERIC) * t.TRADE_QUANTITY   ELSE 0 END) AS tong_gt,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.BUY_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
                         THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY ELSE 0 END)          AS kl_nn_mua,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.SELL_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
                         THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY ELSE 0 END)          AS kl_nn_ban,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.BUY_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
                         THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY * t.trade_price  ELSE 0 END)          AS gt_nn_mua,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.SELL_FOREIGN_INVESTOR_TYPE_CODE IN ('10','20')
                         THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY * t.trade_price ELSE 0 END)          AS gt_nn_ban,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                              AND t.BOARD_ID IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
                         THEN t.TRADE_QUANTITY                                    ELSE 0 END) AS tong_kl_tt,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
                              AND t.BOARD_ID IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
                         THEN CAST(t.TRADE_PRICE AS NUMERIC) * t.TRADE_QUANTITY   ELSE 0 END) AS tong_gt_tt
            FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hnx t
            JOIN uat_mdds_stg.JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx ON t.ISSUE_CODE = idx.SYMBOL
            WHERE t.TRADE_DATE = :ngay_gd 
              AND t.MARKET_ID IN ('STX','UPX')
            GROUP BY t.TRADE_DATE, idx.INDEXCODE,t.ISSUE_CODE
        union all
            SELECT
                idx.INDEXCODE  AS INDEXCODE,
                t.SYMBOL,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                         THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS tong_kl,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                         THEN CAST(REPLACE(t.EXECUTION_VALUE, ',', '') AS DECIMAL(38,2))
                         ELSE 0 END)                                                    AS tong_gt,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.BUY_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
                         THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME ELSE 0 END)        AS kl_nn_mua,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.SELL_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
                         THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME ELSE 0 END)        AS kl_nn_ban,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.BUY_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
                         THEN t.execution_value  ELSE 0 END)        AS gt_nn_mua,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.SELL_FOREIGNER_INVESTOR_TYPE IN ('10','20')
                         THEN t.execution_value ELSE 0 END)        AS gt_nn_ban,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                              AND t.BOARD_TYPE IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
                         THEN t.EXECUTION_VOLUME                    ELSE 0 END)        AS tong_kl_tt,
                SUM(CASE WHEN t.MARKET_ID IN ('STK')
                              AND t.BOARD_TYPE IN ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
                         THEN CAST(REPLACE(t.EXECUTION_VALUE, ',', '') AS DECIMAL(38,2))
                         ELSE 0 END)                                                                                                      AS tong_gt_tt
            FROM uat_ordertrade_stg.trade_book_hose t

WITH params AS (
    SELECT TO_DATE('2025-10-10') AS p_ngay  -- Thay ngày tra cứu
),
all_form_ids AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id, fr.REPORT_CODE
    FROM uat_scms_ods.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE IN ('BCTCHN', 'BCTCRL')
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
),
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (
              SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids WHERE REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
          )
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (
              SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids WHERE REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
          )
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
item_list_hn AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCHN'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCKQHDHN_06622'   -- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG HỢP NHẤT
      AND row_path LIKE '%XI. LỢI NHUẬN KẾ TOÁN SAU THUẾ TNDN%'  -- TS121
      AND column_path = 'Năm nay'
),
item_list_rl AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCRL'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCKQHDR_06610'   -- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG RIÊNG
      AND row_path LIKE '%XI. LỢI NHUẬN KẾ TOÁN SAU THUẾ TNDN%'  -- TS119
      AND column_path = 'Năm nay'
),
item_value_hn AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id,
           CASE WHEN iv.data_type = 'number' AND iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN CAST(iv.value AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_hn)
),
item_value_rl AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id,
           CASE WHEN iv.data_type = 'number' AND iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN CAST(iv.value AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_rl)
),
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
                    p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
),
ctck_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS lnst
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS lnst
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_rl iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT d.sc_firm_info_id, d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD, d.lnst, d.loai_bc_nop,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.sc_firm_info_id
               ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR DESC, d.PERIOD DESC
           ) AS quy_rank
    FROM ctck_data d
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = d.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
      AND d.lnst IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    c.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
    c.SECURITIES_CODE AS ma_ck,
    r.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bao_cao,
    SUM(r.lnst) / 1000000000 AS lnst_4_quy
FROM ranked r
JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = r.sc_firm_info_id
WHERE r.quy_rank <= 4
  AND c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
GROUP BY c.NAME_VI, c.SECURITIES_CODE, r.loai_bc_nop
ORDER BY c.NAME_VI, c.SECURITIES_CODE;

Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        submission_date
        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
			  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
				AND vr.LANGUAGE_CD = 'VI'
				
          )
		  AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
		  AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
		 
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
LNST_theo_quy_all AS (
    SELECT
        cp.equity_ticker AS symbol,
        cdc.report_year, cdc.report_quarter,
        cdc.submission_date,
        vr.base_date,
        d.data_value AS lnst
    FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
    JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                             AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                             AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                                        AND cdc.statement_cd = rc.financial_statement_cd
    JOIN IDS.rrow rr  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN violation_report vr ON vr.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                              AND vr.period_year = cdc.report_year
                              AND vr.period_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
    JOIN forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
    WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
      AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
      AND ((UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN','BH') AND rr.row_desc = '60')
       OR  (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21'))
      AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
      AND vr.language_cd = 'VI'

        cdc.submission_date,

        d.data_value AS vcsh
    FROM Company_data_chuan cdc

                             AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                             AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                                        AND cdc.statement_cd = rc.financial_statement_cd
    JOIN IDS.rrow rr  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN violation_report vr ON vr.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                              AND vr.period_year = cdc.report_year

    JOIN forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
    WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'

LNST_theo_ngay AS (

                PARTITION BY vh.symbol, vh.ngay_gd
                ORDER BY l.report_year DESC, l.report_quarter DESC

        FROM Von_hoa_tung_ma vh

ctck_co_hn AS (

                    p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay

ctck_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path = 'D. VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU'
                                    THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
                    SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%(400 = 410 + 420)%'
                             THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                ) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_rl iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    JOIN item_list_rl il ON il.item_id = iv.item_id
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
)

Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT

        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,

        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD

            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE         WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                                                                WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                                                        END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
                          JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                
          )
                  AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
                  AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
                 
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
LNST_theo_quy_all AS (
    SELECT
        cp.equity_ticker AS symbol,
        cdc.report_year, cdc.report_quarter,
        cdc.submission_date,
        vr.base_date,
        d.data_value AS lnst
    FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
    JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                             AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                             AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id

    JOIN IDS.rrow rr  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN violation_report vr ON vr.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                              AND vr.period_year = cdc.report_year
                              AND vr.period_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
    JOIN forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
    WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
      AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
      AND ((UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN','BH') AND rr.row_desc = '60')
       OR  (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21'))
      AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
      AND vr.language_cd = 'VI'

VCSH_theo_quy_all AS (
    SELECT
        cp.equity_ticker AS symbol,
        cdc.report_year, cdc.report_quarter,
        cdc.submission_date,
        vr.base_date,
        d.data_value AS vcsh
    FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
    JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id

    JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                                        AND cdc.statement_cd = rc.financial_statement_cd
    JOIN IDS.rrow rr  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN violation_report vr ON vr.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                              AND vr.period_year = cdc.report_year
                              AND vr.period_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
    JOIN forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
    WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
      AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
      AND ((UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN','BH') AND rr.row_desc = '400')
       OR  (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '500'))
      AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
      AND vr.language_cd = 'VI'
),
LNST_theo_ngay AS (
    SELECT symbol, ngay_gd,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(lnst) END AS lnst_ttm
    FROM (
        SELECT
            vh.symbol, vh.ngay_gd,
            l.report_year, l.report_quarter, l.lnst,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY vh.symbol, vh.ngay_gd
                ORDER BY l.report_year DESC, l.report_quarter DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Von_hoa_tung_ma vh
        JOIN LNST_theo_quy_all l
            ON l.symbol = vh.symbol
           AND l.base_date < vh.ngay_gd
           AND l.submission_date <= vh.ngay_gd
    )
    WHERE rn <= 4
    GROUP BY symbol, ngay_gd
),
VCSH_theo_ngay AS (
    SELECT symbol, ngay_gd, vcsh 
    FROM (
        SELECT
            vh.symbol, vh.ngay_gd,
            v.vcsh,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY vh.symbol, vh.ngay_gd
                ORDER BY v.report_year DESC, v.report_quarter DESC

        FROM Von_hoa_tung_ma vh
        JOIN VCSH_theo_quy_all v
            ON v.symbol = vh.symbol
           AND v.base_date < vh.ngay_gd
           AND v.submission_date <= vh.ngay_gd
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)

                        ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(n.vwap, 0), s.reference)
                    END
                ELSE s.closeprice
            END AS price,
            s.closeprice,
            s.reference,
            k.d_next,
            n.vwap
        FROM stock_eod s
        CROSS JOIN cal k
        LEFT JOIN stock_eod n
            ON n.symbol = s.symbol
           AND n.tradingdate = k.d_next
        WHERE s.tradingdate = :report_date
          AND s.floorcode IN ('02', '04', '10')
          AND s.stocktype = '2' -- Cổ phiếu
    ) x
LEFT JOIN uat_vsdc_stg.outstanding_shares os ON os.transaction_date = x.tradingdate AND os.ticker_symbol = x.symbol 
)

					AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
					AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc

					AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr

					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
					ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
					AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
					WHERE 1=1
					and  cp.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and  d.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd

					--and d.cell_enabled_flg is not null

,VCSH as 
(
SELECT company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
		--sum (VCSH) VCSH
		VCSH
FROM (
	select company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		NVL(VCSH, TAI_SAN - NO_PT) AS VCSH,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1
	from (
		SELECT company_profile_id,
        	equity_ticker,
        	equity_listing_exch,
        	category_l1_id,
        	report_year,
        	report_quarter,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'TAI_SAN'		THEN data_value END) AS TAI_SAN,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'NO_PT'		THEN data_value END) AS NO_PT,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH'			THEN data_value END) AS VCSH
		FROM Chitiet_DN ct
		where report_quarter in (1,2,3,4,5)
			and TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd')  <= :report_date
			and chi_tieu in ('VCSH', 'TAI_SAN', 'NO_PT')
		GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch,
             category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
		)
	WHERE VCSH IS NOT NULL
   			OR (TAI_SAN IS NOT NULL AND NO_PT IS NOT NULL)
	)
WHERE rn1=1
)
,LNST4Q as 
(
	SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        --SUM(LNST) AS lnst_ttm
        SUM(data_value) AS lnst_ttm
	FROM (

                equity_ticker,
                equity_listing_exch,
                category_l1_id,
                report_year,
                report_quarter,
                chi_tieu, data_value,
                --LNST,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS rn_all,
                CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                       ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) END AS rn_q,
                FIRST_VALUE(report_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id
                                                  ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS q_latest,

        AND     TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= :report_date

     ) t

	GROUP BY

        category_l1_id

    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)

            SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%(400 = 410 + 420)%'

    JOIN item_list_rl_vcsh il ON il.item_id = iv.item_id
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)

      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date

    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

,VCSH as 
(
SELECT company_profile_id,

		VCSH

        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		NVL(VCSH, TAI_SAN - NO_PT) AS VCSH,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1
	from (
		SELECT company_profile_id,
        	equity_ticker,
        	equity_listing_exch,

        	report_year,

		GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch,
             category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter

   			OR (TAI_SAN IS NOT NULL AND NO_PT IS NOT NULL)

,LNST4Q as

                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN theo từng kỳ (dùng chung)

      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)

    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%D. VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU%'
                            THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%(400 = 410 + 420)%'

        ) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_rl_vcsh iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    JOIN item_list_rl_vcsh il ON il.item_id = iv.item_id
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    JOIN item_value_hn_lnst iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)

    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'

    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,

    FROM latest_submission_rl sub

    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

ranked AS (

WITH
Lich_giao_dich AS (
    SELECT ngay, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ngay DESC) AS rn
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT TO_DATE(jm.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay
        FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR jm
        WHERE 1=1
          AND TO_DATE(jm.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
    )
),
Khoang_thoi_gian AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '3_THANG' THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 63)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '6_THANG' THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 126)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '9_THANG' THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 189)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '1_NAM'   THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 252)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = '3_NAM'   THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich WHERE rn <= 756)
            WHEN :loai_khoang = 'TAT_CA'  THEN (SELECT MIN(ngay) FROM Lich_giao_dich)
        END AS ngay_bat_dau,
        TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS ngay_ket_thuc
    FROM DUAL
),
Chi_so AS (
    SELECT marketCode, ngay_gd, diem_dong_cua
    FROM (
        SELECT marketCode, TO_DATE(tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd, marketIndex AS diem_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY marketCode, tradingdate ORDER BY indexTime DESC) AS rn
        FROM JAD_MARKETINFOR
        WHERE marketCode = :chi_so
          AND TO_DATE(tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN
              (SELECT ngay_bat_dau FROM Khoang_thoi_gian) AND (SELECT ngay_ket_thuc FROM Khoang_thoi_gian)
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
Symbol_Index AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM JAD_CSIDXInfor WHERE indexcode = :chi_so
),
Gia_tung_ma AS (
    SELECT symbol, ngay_gd, gia_dong_cua
    FROM (
        SELECT symbol, TO_DATE(tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd, closePrice AS gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol, tradingdate ORDER BY indexTime DESC) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR
        WHERE symbol IN (SELECT symbol FROM Symbol_Index)
          AND TO_DATE(tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN
              (SELECT ngay_bat_dau FROM Khoang_thoi_gian) AND (SELECT ngay_ket_thuc FROM Khoang_thoi_gian)
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
SCPLH AS (
    SELECT
        a.ma_ck AS symbol,
        TO_DATE(a."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_bao_cao,
        SUM(a."Khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành") AS kllh
    FROM "BM 1_Báo cáo về khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành" a
    WHERE a.Loai_CK = 'Co phieu'
      AND a.ma_ck IN (SELECT symbol FROM Symbol_Index)
      AND TO_DATE(a."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= (SELECT ngay_ket_thuc FROM Khoang_thoi_gian)
    GROUP BY a.ma_ck, TO_DATE(a."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY')
),
Ma_ngay_gia AS (
    SELECT c.ngay_gd, si.symbol, g.gia_dong_cua
    FROM Chi_so c
    CROSS JOIN Symbol_Index si
    LEFT JOIN Gia_tung_ma g ON g.symbol = si.symbol AND g.ngay_gd = c.ngay_gd
),
KLLH_asof_ranked AS (
    SELECT m.ngay_gd, m.symbol, m.gia_dong_cua, s.kllh,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.ngay_gd, m.symbol ORDER BY s.ngay_bao_cao DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
    FROM Ma_ngay_gia m
    LEFT JOIN SCPLH s ON s.symbol = m.symbol AND s.ngay_bao_cao <= m.ngay_gd
),
Von_hoa_tung_ma AS (
    SELECT ngay_gd, symbol, gia_dong_cua, kllh,
        CASE WHEN gia_dong_cua IS NOT NULL AND kllh IS NOT NULL THEN gia_dong_cua * kllh END AS von_hoa
    FROM KLLH_asof_ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        submission_date
        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
			  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
				AND vr.LANGUAGE_CD = 'VI'
				
          )
		  AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
		  AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
		 
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
LNST_theo_quy_all AS (
    SELECT
        cp.equity_ticker AS symbol,
        cdc.report_year, cdc.report_quarter,
        cdc.submission_date,
        vr.base_date,
        d.data_value AS lnst
    FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
    JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                             AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                             AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                                        AND cdc.statement_cd = rc.financial_statement_cd
    JOIN IDS.rrow rr  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN violation_report vr ON vr.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                              AND vr.period_year = cdc.report_year
                              AND vr.period_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
    JOIN forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
    WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
      AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
      AND ((UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN','BH') AND rr.row_desc = '60')
       OR  (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21'))
      AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
      AND vr.language_cd = 'VI'
),
VCSH_theo_quy_all AS (
    SELECT
        cp.equity_ticker AS symbol,
        cdc.report_year, cdc.report_quarter,
        cdc.submission_date,
        vr.base_date,
        d.data_value AS vcsh
    FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
    JOIN IDS.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                             AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                             AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                                        AND cdc.statement_cd = rc.financial_statement_cd
    JOIN IDS.rrow rr  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN IDS.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
    JOIN violation_report vr ON vr.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                              AND vr.period_year = cdc.report_year
                              AND vr.period_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
    JOIN forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
    WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
      AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
      AND ((UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN','BH') AND rr.row_desc = '400')
       OR  (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '500'))
      AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
      AND vr.language_cd = 'VI'
),
LNST_theo_ngay AS (
    SELECT symbol, ngay_gd,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(lnst) END AS lnst_ttm
    FROM (
        SELECT
            vh.symbol, vh.ngay_gd,
            l.report_year, l.report_quarter, l.lnst,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY vh.symbol, vh.ngay_gd
                ORDER BY l.report_year DESC, l.report_quarter DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Von_hoa_tung_ma vh
        JOIN LNST_theo_quy_all l
            ON l.symbol = vh.symbol
           AND l.base_date < vh.ngay_gd
           AND l.submission_date <= vh.ngay_gd
    )
    WHERE rn <= 4
    GROUP BY symbol, ngay_gd
),
VCSH_theo_ngay AS (
    SELECT symbol, ngay_gd, vcsh 
    FROM (
        SELECT
            vh.symbol, vh.ngay_gd,
            v.vcsh,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY vh.symbol, vh.ngay_gd
                ORDER BY v.report_year DESC, v.report_quarter DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Von_hoa_tung_ma vh
        JOIN VCSH_theo_quy_all v
            ON v.symbol = vh.symbol
           AND v.base_date < vh.ngay_gd
           AND v.submission_date <= vh.ngay_gd
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    c.marketCode,
    c.ngay_gd,
    c.diem_dong_cua,
    SUM(vh.von_hoa) AS tong_von_hoa_thi_truong,
    
    -- P/E Chỉ số: Chỉ tính Vốn hóa của những mã CÓ dữ liệu LNST TTM
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN ln.lnst_ttm IS NOT NULL THEN vh.von_hoa END) 
        / NULLIF(SUM(ln.lnst_ttm), 0), 
        2
    ) AS pe_chi_so,
    
    -- P/B Chỉ số: Chỉ tính Vốn hóa của những mã CÓ dữ liệu VCSH
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN vc.vcsh IS NOT NULL THEN vh.von_hoa END) 
        / NULLIF(SUM(vc.vcsh), 0), 
        2
    ) AS pb_chi_so

FROM Chi_so c
JOIN Von_hoa_tung_ma vh 
    ON vh.ngay_gd = c.ngay_gd
LEFT JOIN LNST_theo_ngay ln 
    ON ln.symbol = vh.symbol AND ln.ngay_gd = vh.ngay_gd
LEFT JOIN VCSH_theo_ngay vc 
    ON vc.symbol = vh.symbol AND vc.ngay_gd = vh.ngay_gd
GROUP BY c.marketCode, c.ngay_gd, c.diem_dong_cua
ORDER BY c.ngay_gd ASC;

 cal AS (
 select MIN(c.tradingdate  ) AS d_next

 from

  ) c

    SELECT

        x.symbol,
        x.floorcode,
        x.stocktype,
        x.price,
        x.closeprice,
        x.reference,

            s.closeprice,
            s.reference,
            k.d_next,
            n.vwap

-- Tổng 4 quý gần nhất có dữ liệu <= ngày tra cứu
WITH params AS (
    SELECT TO_DATE('2025-10-10') AS p_ngay  -- Thay ngày tra cứu
),
all_form_ids AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id, fr.REPORT_CODE
    FROM uat_scms_ods.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE IN ('BCTCHN', 'BCTCRL')
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
),
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (
              SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids WHERE REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
          )
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (
              SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids WHERE REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
          )
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
item_list_hn AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCHN'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCKQHDHN_06622'   -- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG HỢP NHẤT
      AND row_path LIKE '%XI. LỢI NHUẬN KẾ TOÁN SAU THUẾ TNDN%'  -- TS121
      AND column_path = 'Năm nay'
),
item_list_rl AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCRL'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCKQHDR_06610'   -- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG RIÊNG
      AND row_path LIKE '%XI. LỢI NHUẬN KẾ TOÁN SAU THUẾ TNDN%'  -- TS119
      AND column_path = 'Năm nay'
),
item_value_hn AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id,
           CASE WHEN iv.data_type = 'number' AND iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN CAST(iv.value AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_hn)
),
item_value_rl AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id,
           CASE WHEN iv.data_type = 'number' AND iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN CAST(iv.value AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_rl)
),
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
                    p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
),
ctck_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS lnst
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS lnst
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_rl iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT d.sc_firm_info_id, d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD, d.lnst, d.loai_bc_nop,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.sc_firm_info_id
               ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR DESC, d.PERIOD DESC
           ) AS quy_rank
    FROM ctck_data d
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = d.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
      AND d.lnst IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    c.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
    c.SECURITIES_CODE AS ma_ck,
    r.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bao_cao,
    SUM(r.lnst) / 1000000000 AS lnst_4_quy
FROM ranked r
JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = r.sc_firm_info_id

WITH
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        submission_date
        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
			  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')

          )
		  		AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
				AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
				AND vr.LANGUAGE_CD = 'VI'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
--SELECT * FROM Company_data_chuan 
--WHERE 1=1 
--AND company_profile_id = '1591';
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2:
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy LNST trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Chỉ các kỳ thực sự có LNST mới tồn tại ở đây
   - Xếp thứ tự và lấy 4 kỳ LNST gần nhất
   ========================================================= */
LNST_4_ky AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn     
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cdc.company_profile_id,
                cp.equity_ticker,
                cdc.report_year,
                cdc.report_quarter,
                d.data_value AS lnst
                ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.company_profile_id, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY d.UPDATED_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, d.CREATED_DATE DESC
            ) AS rn1
            FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
               AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
               AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
               AND cdc.STATEMENT_CD = FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
			JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
              AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
              AND (
                     ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'DN' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'BH' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21' )
              )
              /* kỳ phải thực sự có giá trị LNST */
              AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
--              AND cp.equity_ticker = 'HVN'
        ) x
        WHERE x.rn1 = 1
    )
    WHERE rn <= 4
)
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 3:
   Chỉ tính TTM khi đủ 4 kỳ có LNST
   ========================================================= */
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(lnst) END AS lnst_ttm
    FROM LNST_4_ky
    WHERE 1=1
    AND equity_ticker = 'HVN'
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker

				report_year, report_quarter, 
				form_tp,	submission_date,			--20261112

                    	AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='270')
                      	OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='270')
                      	OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='300')) THEN 'TAI_SAN'
                	WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    	AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='300')
                      	OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='300')
                      	OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='400')) THEN 'NO_PT'
                   	WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
						AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
						OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
						OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500')) THEN 'VCSH'
					WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
						AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21')) THEN 'LNST'
					WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
						AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
						OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
						OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03')) THEN 'DOANH_THU'
				END AS chi_tieu,
				data_value
			FROM (
				SELECT x.*,
					ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
						PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id, x.form_tp
						ORDER BY (CASE WHEN cell_enabled_flg is null then 3 else cell_enabled_flg end) ASC,
							x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
					) AS rn
				FROM (
					SELECT
						cdc.company_profile_id,
						cp.equity_ticker,
						cp.equity_listing_exch,
						cp.category_l1_id,
						rc.enterprise_type_cd,
						cdc.report_year,
						cdc.report_quarter,
						rc.report_cd,
						cdc.form_tp,		cdc.submission_date,	d.cell_enabled_flg,	--20261112
						rc2.id AS col_id,
						rc2.col_desc,
						rr.id AS row_id,
						rr.row_desc,
						d.data_value,
						d.created_date,
						d.updated_date,
						d.id AS data_id
					FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
					JOIN 
						(
						select * from 
						(
							select cp.*
									, row_number() over (partition by cp.equity_ticker order by cp.id ASC) as rn 
							from uat_ids_stg.company_profiles cp
							where cp.ds_snpst_dt = :Ngay_gd
							and delete_flg <> 1
						)
						where rn = 1
						) cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d
					ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
					AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
					AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc
					ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
					AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr
					ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
					AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
					ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
					AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
					WHERE 1=1
					and  cp.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and  d.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and rc.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and rr.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and  rc2.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and rc2.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2')
					--and d.cell_enabled_flg is not null
					AND data_value IS NOT null			--20261112
				) x
			) t WHERE rn = 1
		) q WHERE chi_tieu IS NOT NULL
)

,VCSH as 
(
SELECT company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
		--sum (VCSH) VCSH
		VCSH
FROM (
	select company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		NVL(VCSH, TAI_SAN - NO_PT) AS VCSH,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1
	from (
		SELECT company_profile_id,
        	equity_ticker,
        	equity_listing_exch,
        	category_l1_id,
        	report_year,
        	report_quarter,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'TAI_SAN'		THEN data_value END) AS TAI_SAN,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'NO_PT'		THEN data_value END) AS NO_PT,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH'			THEN data_value END) AS VCSH
		FROM Chitiet_DN ct
		where report_quarter in (1,2,3,4,5)
			and TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd')  <= :report_date
			and chi_tieu in ('VCSH', 'TAI_SAN', 'NO_PT')
		GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch,
             category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
		)
	WHERE VCSH IS NOT NULL
   			OR (TAI_SAN IS NOT NULL AND NO_PT IS NOT NULL)
	)
WHERE rn1=1
)
,LNST4Q as 
(
	SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        --SUM(LNST) AS lnst_ttm
        SUM(data_value) AS lnst_ttm
	FROM (
        SELECT  company_profile_id,
                equity_ticker,
                equity_listing_exch,
                category_l1_id,
                report_year,
                report_quarter,
                chi_tieu, data_value,
                --LNST,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS rn_all,
                CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                       ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) END AS rn_q,
                FIRST_VALUE(report_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id
                                                  ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS q_latest,
                -- Số kỳ quý (1-4) công ty đang có
                COUNT(CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id) AS so_quy
        FROM    Chitiet_DN ct

        AND     TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= :report_date
        AND chi_tieu= 'LNST'
     ) t
	WHERE   (q_latest = 5  AND rn_all = 1)                   -- Kỳ gần nhất là năm -> lấy kỳ năm
	OR   (q_latest <> 5 AND rn_q <= 4

    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)

                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD

    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

with stock_eod as 
 (
 select * from 
 (
 select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.symbol,tradingdate ORDER BY s.tradingtime desc,s.`sequence` desc ) AS rn1
                        , s.*
                FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor s
                ) where rn1 =1 
                )  
,cal AS (
 select MIN(c.tradingdate  ) AS d_next
-- , MAX(case when c.tradingdate <= :report_date then c.tradingdate END ) d_cur
 from 
 (
  SELECT DISTINCT TO_DATE(h.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS tradingdate
  FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book h
  WHERE h.trade_date > DATE_FORMAT(:report_date, 'yyyyMMdd')
    AND h.trade_date <= DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(:report_date, 1), 'yyyyMMdd')
  UNION  
  SELECT DISTINCT m.tradingdate
  FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_marketinfor m
  WHERE m.tradingdate > :report_date AND m.tradingdate <= ADD_MONTHS(:report_date, 1)
  ) c
)
,Von_hoa as
(
    SELECT
        x.tradingdate,
        x.symbol,
        x.floorcode,
        x.stocktype,
        x.price,
        x.closeprice,
        x.reference,
        x.d_next,
        x.vwap,
        os.outstanding_shares AS kllh_cp,
        x.price * os.outstanding_shares AS von_hoa_cophieu
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.tradingdate,
            s.symbol,
            s.floorcode,
            s.stocktype,
            CASE
                WHEN s.floorcode = '04' THEN
                    CASE
                        -- Chưa có VWAP tại T+1: chưa tính vốn hóa
                        WHEN n.vwap IS NULL THEN NULL
                        -- VWAP = 0: lấy giá tham chiếu ngày T
                        ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(n.vwap, 0), s.reference)
                    END
                ELSE s.closeprice
            END AS price,
            s.closeprice,
            s.reference,
            k.d_next,
            n.vwap
        FROM stock_eod s
        CROSS JOIN cal k
        LEFT JOIN stock_eod n
            ON n.symbol = s.symbol
           AND n.tradingdate = k.d_next
        WHERE s.tradingdate = :report_date
          AND s.floorcode IN ('02', '04', '10')
          AND s.stocktype = '2' -- Cổ phiếu
    ) x
LEFT JOIN uat_vsdc_stg.outstanding_shares os ON os.transaction_date = x.tradingdate AND os.ticker_symbol = x.symbol 
)

								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2---TH
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 3--ME
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 4--RI
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn

				rn, company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id,
				report_year, report_quarter, 
				form_tp,	submission_date,			--20261112			
				CASE
					WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    	AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='270')
                      	OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='270')
                      	OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='300')) THEN 'TAI_SAN'
                	WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    	AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='300')
                      	OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='300')
                      	OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='400')) THEN 'NO_PT'
                   	WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
						AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
						OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
						OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500')) THEN 'VCSH'
					WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
						AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21')) THEN 'LNST'
					WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
						AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
						OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
						OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03')) THEN 'DOANH_THU'
				END AS chi_tieu,
				data_value
			FROM (
				SELECT x.*,
					ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
						PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id, x.form_tp
						ORDER BY (CASE WHEN cell_enabled_flg is null then 3 else cell_enabled_flg end) ASC,
							x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
					) AS rn
				FROM (
					SELECT
						cdc.company_profile_id,
						cp.equity_ticker,
						cp.equity_listing_exch,
						cp.category_l1_id,
						rc.enterprise_type_cd,
						cdc.report_year,
						cdc.report_quarter,
						rc.report_cd,
						cdc.form_tp,		cdc.submission_date,	d.cell_enabled_flg,	--20261112
						rc2.id AS col_id,
						rc2.col_desc,
						rr.id AS row_id,
						rr.row_desc,
						d.data_value,
						d.created_date,
						d.updated_date,
						d.id AS data_id
					FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
					JOIN 
						(
						select * from 
						(
							select cp.*
									, row_number() over (partition by cp.equity_ticker order by cp.id ASC) as rn 
							from uat_ids_stg.company_profiles cp
							where cp.ds_snpst_dt = :Ngay_gd
							and delete_flg <> 1
						)
						where rn = 1
						) cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d
					ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
					AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
					AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc
					ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
					AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr
					ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
					AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
					ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
					AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
					WHERE 1=1
					and  cp.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and  d.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and rc.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and rr.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and  rc2.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and rc2.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2')
					--and d.cell_enabled_flg is not null
					AND data_value IS NOT null			--20261112
				) x
			) t WHERE rn = 1
		) q WHERE chi_tieu IS NOT NULL
)

,VCSH as 
(
SELECT company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
		--sum (VCSH) VCSH
		VCSH
FROM (
	select company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		NVL(VCSH, TAI_SAN - NO_PT) AS VCSH,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1
	from (
		SELECT company_profile_id,
        	equity_ticker,

        	report_year,
        	report_quarter,

        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH'			THEN data_value END) AS VCSH
		FROM Chitiet_DN ct
		where report_quarter in (1,2,3,4,5)
			and TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd')  <= :report_date

		GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch,
             category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
		)
	WHERE VCSH IS NOT NULL
   			OR (TAI_SAN IS NOT NULL AND NO_PT IS NOT NULL)
	)
WHERE rn1=1

,LNST4Q as

	SELECT

                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

     ) t

                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD

    CROSS JOIN params pr

    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)

      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

/* BƯỚC 1:
           Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
           - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
           - company_data phải APPROVED
           - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
           - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
           - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
        */
        Company_data_chuan AS (
                SELECT
                        company_profile_id,
                        report_year,
                        report_quarter,
                        company_data_id,
                        form_cd,
                        submission_date
                        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
                FROM (
                        SELECT
                                cd.company_profile_id,
                                cd.report_year,
                                cd.report_quarter,
                                cd.id AS company_data_id,
                                f.form_cd,
                                cd.submission_date,
                                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                                        ORDER BY CASE         WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                                                                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                                                                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                                                                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                                                                END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
                        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
                        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
                          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
                          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
                                  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
                                  WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                                        AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                                        AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                                        AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
                          )
                                  AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
                                AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
                )
                WHERE rn = 1
        ),
        --SELECT * FROM Company_data_chuan 
        --WHERE 1=1 
        --AND company_profile_id = '1591';
        /* =========================================================
           BƯỚC 2:
           - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy VCSH trong DATA
           - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
           - Chỉ các kỳ thực sự có VCSH mới tồn tại ở đây
           - lấy 1 kỳ LNST gần nhất
           ========================================================= */
        VCSH_quy AS (
                SELECT
                        equity_ticker,
                        report_year,
                        report_quarter,
                        vcsh,
                        company_profile_id
                FROM (
                        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1   
                        FROM 
                        (
                        SELECT
                                cp.equity_ticker,
                                d.report_year,
                                d.report_quarter,
                                d.data_value AS vcsh,
                                cdc.company_profile_id,
                                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                        PARTITION BY
                                                d.company_profile_id,
                                                d.report_year,
                                                d.report_quarter
                                        ORDER BY
                                                d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                                                d.created_date DESC
                                ) AS rn
                        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
                                ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
                                ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
                                ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
                                ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
                           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
                                ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
                           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
                          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
                          AND (
                                  (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
                                   AND rr.row_desc = '400')
                                  OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                                          AND rr.row_desc = '500')
                          )
                ) x
                WHERE rn = 1
        )
        WHERE rn= 1
                )

                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD

with stock_eod as 
 (
 select * from

                        , s.*
                FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor s
                ) where rn1 =1 
                )  
,cal AS (
 select MIN(c.tradingdate  ) AS d_next
-- , MAX(case when c.tradingdate <= :report_date then c.tradingdate END ) d_cur
 from 
 (
  SELECT DISTINCT TO_DATE(h.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS tradingdate
  FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book h
  WHERE h.trade_date > DATE_FORMAT(:report_date, 'yyyyMMdd')
    AND h.trade_date <= DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(:report_date, 1), 'yyyyMMdd')
  UNION  
  SELECT DISTINCT m.tradingdate
  FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_marketinfor m
  WHERE m.tradingdate > :report_date AND m.tradingdate <= ADD_MONTHS(:report_date, 1)
  ) c
)
,Von_hoa as
(
    SELECT
        x.tradingdate,
        x.symbol,
        x.floorcode,
        x.stocktype,
        x.price,
        x.closeprice,
        x.reference,
        x.d_next,
        x.vwap,
        os.outstanding_shares AS kllh_cp,
        x.price * os.outstanding_shares AS von_hoa_cophieu
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.tradingdate,
            s.symbol,
            s.floorcode,
            s.stocktype,
            CASE
                WHEN s.floorcode = '04' THEN
                    CASE
                        -- Chưa có VWAP tại T+1: chưa tính vốn hóa
                        WHEN n.vwap IS NULL THEN NULL
                        -- VWAP = 0: lấy giá tham chiếu ngày T
                        ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(n.vwap, 0), s.reference)
                    END
                ELSE s.closeprice
            END AS price,
            s.closeprice,
            s.reference,
            k.d_next,
            n.vwap
        FROM stock_eod s
        CROSS JOIN cal k
        LEFT JOIN stock_eod n
            ON n.symbol = s.symbol
           AND n.tradingdate = k.d_next
        WHERE s.tradingdate = :report_date
          AND s.floorcode IN ('02', '04', '10')
          AND s.stocktype = '2' -- Cổ phiếu
    ) x
LEFT JOIN uat_vsdc_stg.outstanding_shares os ON os.transaction_date = x.tradingdate AND os.ticker_symbol = x.symbol

                      	OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='300')
                      	OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='400')) THEN 'NO_PT'
