				END AS chi_tieu,
				data_value
			FROM (
				SELECT x.*,
					ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
						PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id, x.form_tp
						ORDER BY (CASE WHEN cell_enabled_flg is null then 3 else cell_enabled_flg end) ASC,

					) AS rn
				FROM (
					SELECT
						cdc.company_profile_id,
						cp.equity_ticker,

						cp.category_l1_id,

						cdc.report_quarter,
						rc.report_cd,
						cdc.form_tp,		cdc.submission_date,	d.cell_enabled_flg,	--20261112

						d.created_date,

						d.id AS data_id

					JOIN

						select * from 
						(

							from uat_ids_stg.company_profiles cp

						)
						where rn = 1
						) cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d
					ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
					AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
					AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc
					ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
					AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr
					ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
					AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
					ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
					AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
					WHERE 1=1
					and  cp.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and  d.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and rc.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and rr.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and  rc2.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and rc2.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2')
					--and d.cell_enabled_flg is not null
					AND data_value IS NOT null			--20261112
				) x
			) t WHERE rn = 1
		) q WHERE chi_tieu IS NOT NULL
)

,VCSH as 
(
SELECT company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
		--sum (VCSH) VCSH
		VCSH
FROM (
	select company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		NVL(VCSH, TAI_SAN - NO_PT) AS VCSH,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1
	from (
		SELECT company_profile_id,
        	equity_ticker,
        	equity_listing_exch,
        	category_l1_id,
        	report_year,
        	report_quarter,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'TAI_SAN'		THEN data_value END) AS TAI_SAN,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'NO_PT'		THEN data_value END) AS NO_PT,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH'			THEN data_value END) AS VCSH
		FROM Chitiet_DN ct
		where report_quarter in (1,2,3,4,5)
			and TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd')  <= :report_date
			and chi_tieu in ('VCSH', 'TAI_SAN', 'NO_PT')
		GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch,
             category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
		)
	WHERE VCSH IS NOT NULL
   			OR (TAI_SAN IS NOT NULL AND NO_PT IS NOT NULL)
	)
WHERE rn1=1
)
,LNST4Q as 
(
	SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        --SUM(LNST) AS lnst_ttm
        SUM(data_value) AS lnst_ttm
	FROM (
        SELECT  company_profile_id,
                equity_ticker,
                equity_listing_exch,
                category_l1_id,
                report_year,
                report_quarter,
                chi_tieu, data_value,
                --LNST,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS rn_all,
                CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                       ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) END AS rn_q,
                FIRST_VALUE(report_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id
                                                  ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS q_latest,
                -- Số kỳ quý (1-4) công ty đang có
                COUNT(CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id) AS so_quy
        FROM    Chitiet_DN ct

        AND     TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= :report_date
        AND chi_tieu= 'LNST'
     ) t
	WHERE   (q_latest = 5  AND rn_all = 1)                   -- Kỳ gần nhất là năm -> lấy kỳ năm
	OR   (q_latest <> 5 AND rn_q <= 4

    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)

Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        statement_cd,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) AS statement_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    cd.company_profile_id,
                    cd.report_year,
                    cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                    END,
                    cd.submission_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f
            ON f.id = cd.form_id
           AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
          AND cd.submission_date <= ts.den_ngay
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
              JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf
                  ON vf.id = vr.form_id
                 AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= ts.den_ngay
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Doanh thu theo từng kỳ BCTC */
Doanh_thu AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        doanh_thu,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            cp.equity_ticker,
            cdc.report_year,
            cdc.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS doanh_thu,
            cdc.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '10')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '03')
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)

-- Tỷ lệ KLGD / KLGDTB 5 ngày
 WITH daily_kl AS (
  SELECT [Symbol] AS symbol, [Trade Date] AS tdate,
  SUM([Execution - Volume]) AS klgd
  FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE
  WHERE [Market ID] IN ('STO','STX','UPX')
  AND [Board Type] IN ('G1','G2','G3','G4',
  'T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
  AND [Trade Date] BETWEEN :ngay_gd - 5 AND :ngay_gd
  GROUP BY [Symbol],[Trade Date]
  UNION ALL
  SELECT [Issue Code],[Trade date],SUM([Trade quantity])
  FROM Trade_HNX
  WHERE [Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX')
  AND [Trade date] BETWEEN :ngay_gd - 5 AND :ngay_gd
  GROUP BY [Issue Code],[Trade date]
 ),
 klgd_today AS (
  SELECT symbol, klgd FROM daily_kl WHERE tdate = :ngay_gd
 ),
 klgdtb AS (
  SELECT symbol, AVG(klgd) AS klgdtb_5
  FROM daily_kl WHERE tdate < :ngay_gd
  GROUP BY symbol
 )
 SELECT t.symbol,
  t.klgd AS klgd_today,
  b.klgdtb_5 AS klgdtb_5ngay,
  CASE WHEN b.klgdtb_5 > 0
  THEN ROUND(t.klgd / b.klgdtb_5, 2)
  ELSE NULL END AS ty_le_5ngay
 FROM klgd_today t
 JOIN klgdtb b ON t.symbol = b.symbol
 ORDER BY ty_le_5ngay DESC;

  FROM daily_kl WHERE tdate < :ngay_gd
  GROUP BY symbol
 )

  t.klgd AS klgd_today,
  b.klgdtb_20 AS klgdtb_20ngay,
  CASE WHEN b.klgdtb_20 > 0
  THEN ROUND(t.klgd / b.klgdtb_20, 2)
  ELSE NULL END AS ty_le_20ngay
 FROM klgd_today t
 JOIN klgdtb b ON t.symbol = b.symbol
 ORDER BY ty_le_20ngay DESC;

  UNION

  ) c

                        -- VWAP = 0: lấy giá tham chiếu ngày T
                        ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(n.vwap, 0), s.reference)
                    END

            END AS price,
            s.closeprice,
            s.reference,
            k.d_next,
            n.vwap

/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        submission_date
        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
			  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')

          )
		  		AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
				AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
				AND vr.LANGUAGE_CD = 'VI'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),

/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2:
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy LNST trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Chỉ các kỳ thực sự có LNST mới tồn tại ở đây
   - Xếp thứ tự và lấy 4 kỳ LNST gần nhất
   ========================================================= */
LNST_4_ky AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn     
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cdc.company_profile_id,
                cp.equity_ticker,
                cdc.report_year,
                cdc.report_quarter,
                d.data_value AS lnst
                ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.company_profile_id, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY d.UPDATED_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, d.CREATED_DATE DESC
            ) AS rn1
            FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
               AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
               AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
               AND cdc.STATEMENT_CD = FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
			JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
              AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
              AND (
                     ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'DN' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'BH' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21' )
              )
              /* kỳ phải thực sự có giá trị LNST */
              AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
--              AND cp.equity_ticker = 'HVN'
        ) x
        WHERE x.rn1 = 1
    )
    WHERE rn <= 4
)
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 3:
   Chỉ tính TTM khi đủ 4 kỳ có LNST
   ========================================================= */
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(lnst) END AS lnst_ttm
    FROM LNST_4_ky
    WHERE 1=1
    AND equity_ticker = 'HVN'
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker

    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.sc_firm_info_id

      AND d.lnst IS NOT NULL

-- Kết quả Vốn CSH theo CTCK
von_csh_ctck AS (

        c.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
        c.SECURITIES_CODE AS ma_ck,

      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_rl)

ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
                    p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)

    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)

ctck_data AS (

    SELECT

    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,

    JOIN item_value_rl iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

ranked AS (

           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.sc_firm_info_id
               ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR DESC, d.PERIOD DESC
           ) AS quy_rank
    FROM ctck_data d
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = d.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')

JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = r.sc_firm_info_id

GROUP BY c.NAME_VI, c.SECURITIES_CODE, r.loai_bc_nop
ORDER BY c.NAME_VI, c.SECURITIES_CODE;

,VCSH as 
(
SELECT company_profile_id,

		VCSH

		GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch,
             category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter

   			OR (TAI_SAN IS NOT NULL AND NO_PT IS NOT NULL)

,LNST4Q as

	SELECT

                equity_ticker,

                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

/* BƯỚC 1:
           Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
           - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
           - company_data phải APPROVED
           - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
           - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
           - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
        */
        Company_data_chuan AS (
                SELECT
                        company_profile_id,
                        report_year,
                        report_quarter,
                        company_data_id,
                        form_cd,
                        submission_date
                        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
                FROM (
                        SELECT
                                cd.company_profile_id,
                                cd.report_year,
                                cd.report_quarter,
                                cd.id AS company_data_id,
                                f.form_cd,
                                cd.submission_date,
                                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                                        ORDER BY CASE         WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                                                                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                                                                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                                                                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                                                                END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
                        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
                        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
                          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
                          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
                                  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
                                  WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                                        AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                                        AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                                        AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
                          )
                                  AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
                                AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
                )
                WHERE rn = 1
        ),
        --SELECT * FROM Company_data_chuan

        --AND company_profile_id = '1591';
        /* =========================================================
           BƯỚC 2:
           - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy VCSH trong DATA
           - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
           - Chỉ các kỳ thực sự có VCSH mới tồn tại ở đây
           - lấy 1 kỳ LNST gần nhất

        VCSH_quy AS (
                SELECT
                        equity_ticker,
                        report_year,
                        report_quarter,
                        vcsh,
                        company_profile_id
                FROM (
                        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1   
                        FROM 
                        (
                        SELECT
                                cp.equity_ticker,
                                d.report_year,
                                d.report_quarter,
                                d.data_value AS vcsh,
                                cdc.company_profile_id,
                                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                                        PARTITION BY
                                                d.company_profile_id,
                                                d.report_year,
                                                d.report_quarter
                                        ORDER BY
                                                d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                                                d.created_date DESC
                                ) AS rn
                        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
                                ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
                                ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
                                ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
                                ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
                           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
                                ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
                           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
                          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
                          AND (

                                  OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                                          AND rr.row_desc = '500')
                          )
                ) x
                WHERE rn = 1
        )

                        WHEN n.vwap IS NULL THEN NULL
                        -- VWAP = 0: lấy giá tham chiếu ngày T
                        ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(n.vwap, 0), s.reference)
                    END
                ELSE s.closeprice
            END AS price,
            s.closeprice,
            s.reference,
            k.d_next,
            n.vwap
        FROM stock_eod s
        CROSS JOIN cal k
        LEFT JOIN stock_eod n
            ON n.symbol = s.symbol
           AND n.tradingdate = k.d_next
        WHERE s.tradingdate = :report_date
          AND s.floorcode IN ('02', '04', '10')
          AND s.stocktype = '2' -- Cổ phiếu

					AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
					AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc

					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr

					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
					ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd

					WHERE 1=1
					and  cp.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd

,VCSH as 
(
SELECT company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
		--sum (VCSH) VCSH
		VCSH
FROM (
	select company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		NVL(VCSH, TAI_SAN - NO_PT) AS VCSH,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1
	from (
		SELECT company_profile_id,
        	equity_ticker,
        	equity_listing_exch,
        	category_l1_id,
        	report_year,
        	report_quarter,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'TAI_SAN'		THEN data_value END) AS TAI_SAN,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'NO_PT'		THEN data_value END) AS NO_PT,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH'			THEN data_value END) AS VCSH
		FROM Chitiet_DN ct
		where report_quarter in (1,2,3,4,5)
			and TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd')  <= :report_date
			and chi_tieu in ('VCSH', 'TAI_SAN', 'NO_PT')
		GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch,
             category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
		)
	WHERE VCSH IS NOT NULL
   			OR (TAI_SAN IS NOT NULL AND NO_PT IS NOT NULL)
	)
WHERE rn1=1
)
,LNST4Q as 
(
	SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        --SUM(LNST) AS lnst_ttm
        SUM(data_value) AS lnst_ttm
	FROM (
        SELECT  company_profile_id,
                equity_ticker,
                equity_listing_exch,
                category_l1_id,
                report_year,
                report_quarter,
                chi_tieu, data_value,
                --LNST,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS rn_all,
                CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                       ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) END AS rn_q,
                FIRST_VALUE(report_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id
                                                  ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS q_latest,

        AND     TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= :report_date
        AND chi_tieu= 'LNST'
     ) t
	WHERE   (q_latest = 5  AND rn_all = 1)                   -- Kỳ gần nhất là năm -> lấy kỳ năm

	GROUP BY

        category_l1_id

    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)

            SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%(400 = 410 + 420)%'

    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD

      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date

    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)

-- Latest submission của BCTCHN
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID

        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,

-- Latest submission của BCTCRL
latest_submission_rl AS (

-- item_value của BCTCHN
item_value_hn AS (

    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv

-- item_value của BCTCRL
item_value_rl AS (

-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
                    p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)

),
ctck_data AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path = 'D. VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU'
                                    THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
                    SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%(400 = 410 + 420)%'
                             THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                ) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_rl iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    JOIN item_list_rl il ON il.item_id = iv.item_id
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
)

    FROM uat_scms_ods.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE IN ('BCTCHN', 'BCTCRL')
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
),
-- Quý gần nhất có dữ liệu <= ngày tra cứu (chỉ dùng cho Vốn CSH)
latest_quy AS (
    SELECT p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub ON CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING) = CAST(p.ID AS STRING)
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT null
      and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1
--      AND c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
      AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
    ORDER BY p.REPORT_YEAR DESC, p.PERIOD DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Latest submission (dùng chung cho cả 2 chỉ tiêu)
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (
              SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids WHERE REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
          )
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (
              SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids WHERE REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
          )
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
-- item_list: Vốn CSH
item_list_hn_vcsh AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCHN'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCTCH_06620'
      AND row_path LIKE '%VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU (400 = 410 + 420)%'  -- TS359
      AND column_path LIKE '%Số cuối năm%'
),
item_list_rl_vcsh AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCRL'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCTCR_06608'
      AND column_path LIKE '%Số cuối năm%'
      AND (
          row_path LIKE '%D. VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU%'      -- TS223
          OR row_path LIKE '%(400 = 410 + 420)%'   -- TS221
      )
),
-- item_list: Lợi nhuận sau thuế
item_list_hn_lnst AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCHN'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCKQHDHN_06622'   -- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG HỢP NHẤT
      AND row_path LIKE '%XI. LỢI NHUẬN KẾ TOÁN SAU THUẾ TNDN%'  -- TS121
      AND column_path LIKE '%Năm nay%'
),
item_list_rl_lnst AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCRL'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCKQHDR_06610'    -- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG RIÊNG
      AND row_path LIKE '%XI. LỢI NHUẬN KẾ TOÁN SAU THUẾ TNDN%'  -- TS119
      AND column_path LIKE '%Năm nay%'
),
-- item_value: Vốn CSH
item_value_hn_vcsh AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id, iv.value,
           CASE WHEN iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN TRY_CAST(iv.value AS decimal(38,10)) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_hn_vcsh)
),
item_value_rl_vcsh AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id, iv.value,
           CASE WHEN iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN TRY_CAST(iv.value AS decimal(38,10)) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_rl_vcsh)
),
-- item_value: Lợi nhuận sau thuế
item_value_hn_lnst AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id,
           CASE WHEN iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN TRY_CAST(iv.value AS decimal(38,10)) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_hn_lnst)
),
item_value_rl_lnst AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id,
           CASE WHEN iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN TRY_CAST(iv.value AS decimal(38,10)) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_rl_lnst)
),
-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN theo từng kỳ (dùng chung)
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
                    p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
),
-- Vốn CSH: chỉ quý gần nhất
ctck_data_vcsh AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn_vcsh iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%D. VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU%'
                            THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%(400 = 410 + 420)%'
                     THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_rl_vcsh iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    JOIN item_list_rl_vcsh il ON il.item_id = iv.item_id
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
),
-- LNST: tất cả các quý <= ngày tra cứu
ctck_data_lnst AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS lnst
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn_lnst iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS lnst
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_rl_lnst iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT d.sc_firm_info_id, d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD, d.lnst, d.loai_bc_nop,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.sc_firm_info_id
               ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR DESC, d.PERIOD DESC
           ) AS quy_rank
    FROM ctck_data_lnst d
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = d.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE 1=1
    and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1
	--c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
      AND d.lnst IS NOT NULL
),
-- Kết quả Vốn CSH theo CTCK
von_csh_ctck AS (
    SELECT
        c.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
        c.SECURITIES_CODE AS ma_ck,
        d.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bc_von_csh,
        CONCAT('Q', CAST(d.PERIOD AS STRING), '/', CAST(d.REPORT_YEAR AS STRING)) AS quy_du_lieu,
        d.von_csh  AS von_csh
    FROM ctck_data_vcsh d
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = d.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE 1=1
    and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1
--    and c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
),
-- Kết quả LNST 4 quý theo CTCK
lnst_ctck AS (
    SELECT
        c.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
        c.SECURITIES_CODE AS ma_ck,
        r.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bc_lnst,
        SUM(r.lnst) AS lnst_4_quy
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = r.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE r.quy_rank <= 4
    and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1
     -- AND c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
    GROUP BY c.NAME_VI, c.SECURITIES_CODE, r.loai_bc_nop
)
,LN_VCSH_CTCK as
(
SELECT
    COALESCE(v.ten_ctck, l.ten_ctck) AS ten_ctck,
    COALESCE(v.ma_ck, l.ma_ck)       AS ma_ck,
    v.loai_bc_von_csh,
    v.quy_du_lieu,
    v.von_csh,
    l.loai_bc_lnst,
    l.lnst_4_quy
FROM von_csh_ctck v
FULL OUTER JOIN lnst_ctck l ON v.ma_ck = l.ma_ck
ORDER BY ten_ctck, ma_ck
)
--select * from LN_VCSH_CTCK
select vh.von_hoa_cophieu
,ROUND(von_hoa_cophieu / NULLIF(LNST, 0), 2) AS pe
,ROUND(von_hoa_cophieu / NULLIF(vcsh, 0), 2) AS pb
,x.*
from Von_hoa vh 
left join 
(
      SELECT 'IDS'  AS period_tag, 
      equity_ticker Ma_CK,
      lnst_ttm LNST,
      vcsh VCSH
      FROM LN_VCSH_IDS -- IDS
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'SCMS' AS period_tag, 
      a.ma_ck,
      lnst_4_quy LNST,
      von_csh VCSH
      FROM LN_VCSH_CTCK a -- SCMS
      ) x on vh.symbol = x.Ma_CK

-- Tỷ lệ KLGD / KLGDTB 5 ngày
 WITH daily_kl AS (
  SELECT [Symbol] AS symbol, [Trade Date] AS tdate,
  SUM([Execution - Volume]) AS klgd
  FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE
  WHERE [Market ID] IN ('STO','STX','UPX')
  AND [Board Type] IN ('G1','G2','G3','G4',
  'T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
  AND [Trade Date] BETWEEN :ngay_gd - 5 AND :ngay_gd
  GROUP BY [Symbol],[Trade Date]
  UNION ALL
  SELECT [Issue Code],[Trade date],SUM([Trade quantity])
  FROM Trade_HNX
  WHERE [Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX')
  AND [Trade date] BETWEEN :ngay_gd - 5 AND :ngay_gd
  GROUP BY [Issue Code],[Trade date]
 ),
 klgd_today AS (
  SELECT symbol, klgd FROM daily_kl WHERE tdate = :ngay_gd
 ),
 klgdtb AS (
  SELECT symbol, AVG(klgd) AS klgdtb_5
  FROM daily_kl WHERE tdate < :ngay_gd
  GROUP BY symbol
 )
 SELECT t.symbol,
  t.klgd AS klgd_today,
  b.klgdtb_5 AS klgdtb_5ngay,
  CASE WHEN b.klgdtb_5 > 0
  THEN ROUND(t.klgd / b.klgdtb_5, 2)
  ELSE NULL END AS ty_le_5ngay
 FROM klgd_today t
 JOIN klgdtb b ON t.symbol = b.symbol
 ORDER BY ty_le_5ngay DESC;

-- KLGDTB 10 ngày gần nhất (trước :ngay_gd)
 WITH daily_kl AS (
  SELECT [Symbol] AS symbol, [Trade Date] AS tdate,
  SUM([Execution - Volume]) AS klgd
  FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE
  WHERE [Trade Date] BETWEEN :ngay_gd - 10 AND :ngay_gd - 1
  AND [Market ID] IN ('STO','STX','UPX')
  AND [Board Type] IN ('G1','G2','G3','G4',
  'T1','T2','T3','T4','T6')
  GROUP BY [Symbol],[Trade Date]
  UNION ALL
  SELECT [Issue Code],[Trade date],SUM([Trade quantity])
  FROM Trade_HNX
  WHERE [Trade date] BETWEEN :ngay_gd - 10 AND :ngay_gd - 1
  AND [Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX')
  GROUP BY [Issue Code],[Trade date]
 )
 SELECT symbol,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tdate) AS so_phien_tinh,
  AVG(klgd) AS klgdtb_10ngay
 FROM daily_kl
 GROUP BY symbol;

Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd, form_tp,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
			substr(f.form_cd,1,2) as form_tp,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM UAT_IDS_STG.company_data cd
        JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND cd.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
          AND f.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
--    AND report_year in (:p_year)
--	AND report_quarter in (:p_quarter)
),
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		Case when report_quarter = 1 then to_date ('31-03-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 2 then to_date ('30-06-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 3 then to_date ('30-09-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy')
			when report_quarter = 4 then to_date ('31-12-'||report_year , 'dd-MM-yyyy') 
			end as Ngay_ket_thuc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH' THEN data_value END) AS VCSH,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'LNST' THEN data_value END) AS LNST,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'DOANH_THU' THEN data_value END) AS DOANH_THU
    FROM (
        SELECT
            rn, company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id,
            report_year, report_quarter,
            CASE
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500')) THEN 'VCSH'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21')) THEN 'LNST'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03')) THEN 'DOANH_THU'
            END AS chi_tieu,
            data_value
        FROM (
            SELECT x.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id
                       ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    cdc.company_profile_id,
                    cp.equity_ticker,
                    cp.equity_listing_exch,
                    cp.category_l1_id,
                    rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                    cdc.report_year,
                    cdc.report_quarter,
                    rc.report_cd,
                    rc2.id AS col_id,
                    rc2.col_desc,
                    rr.id AS row_id,
                    rr.row_desc,
                    d.data_value,
                    d.created_date,
                    d.updated_date,
                    d.id AS data_id
                FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp
                  ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d
                  ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                 AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                 AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc
                  ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                 AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr
                  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
                 AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
                  ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
                 AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                WHERE 1=1
                and cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND d.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2')
            ) x
        ) t
        WHERE rn = 1
    ) q
    WHERE chi_tieu IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
)

    FROM (
        SELECT

                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500')) THEN 'VCSH'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'

                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21')) THEN 'LNST'

                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03')) THEN 'DOANH_THU'
            END AS chi_tieu,
            data_value
        FROM (
            SELECT x.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id
                       ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC

                    cp.equity_listing_exch,

                    rc.enterprise_type_cd,

                    d.updated_date,
                    d.id AS data_id

                  ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d
                  ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                 AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                 AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc
                  ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                 AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr
                  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
                 AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
                  ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
                 AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                WHERE 1=1
                and cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND d.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2')
            ) x
        ) t
        WHERE rn = 1
    ) q
    WHERE chi_tieu IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter

    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.sc_firm_info_id

      AND d.lnst IS NOT NULL

-- Kết quả Vốn CSH theo CTCK
von_csh_ctck AS (

        c.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
        c.SECURITIES_CODE AS ma_ck,

      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_rl)

ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
                    p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)

    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)

ctck_data AS (

    SELECT

    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,

    JOIN item_value_rl iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

ranked AS (

           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.sc_firm_info_id
               ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR DESC, d.PERIOD DESC
           ) AS quy_rank
    FROM ctck_data d
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = d.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')

JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = r.sc_firm_info_id

GROUP BY c.NAME_VI, c.SECURITIES_CODE, r.loai_bc_nop
ORDER BY c.NAME_VI, c.SECURITIES_CODE;

,VCSH as 
(
SELECT company_profile_id,

		VCSH

		GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch,
             category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter

   			OR (TAI_SAN IS NOT NULL AND NO_PT IS NOT NULL)

,LNST4Q as

	SELECT

                equity_ticker,

                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2: tính các chỉ tiêu theo từng DN, từng kỳ
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy chỉ tiêu trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Điều kiện FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD = form_tp
   - Cùng chỉ tiêu: lấy create_date mới nhất
   ========================================================= */
Chitiet_DN AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH' THEN data_value END) AS VCSH,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'LNST' THEN data_value END) AS LNST,
        SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'DOANH_THU' THEN data_value END) AS DOANH_THU
    FROM (
        SELECT
            rn, company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id,
            report_year, report_quarter,
            CASE
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='400')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='500')) THEN 'VCSH'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='60')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='21')) THEN 'LNST'
                WHEN col_desc = '1' AND report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
                    AND ((upper(enterprise_type_cd)='DN' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='BH' AND row_desc='10')
                      OR (upper(enterprise_type_cd)='TD' AND row_desc='03')) THEN 'DOANH_THU'
            END AS chi_tieu,
            data_value
        FROM (
            SELECT x.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id, x.report_year, x.report_quarter, x.row_id, x.col_id
                       ORDER BY x.updated_date DESC, x.created_date DESC, x.data_id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    cdc.company_profile_id,
                    cp.equity_ticker,
                    cp.equity_listing_exch,
                    cp.category_l1_id,
                    rc.enterprise_type_cd,
                    cdc.report_year,
                    cdc.report_quarter,
                    rc.report_cd,
                    rc2.id AS col_id,
                    rc2.col_desc,
                    rr.id AS row_id,
                    rr.row_desc,
                    d.data_value,
                    d.created_date,
                    d.updated_date,
                    d.id AS data_id
                FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.company_profiles cp
                  ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d
                  ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
                 AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
                 AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc
                  ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
                 AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr
                  ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
                 AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
                  ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
                 AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
                WHERE 1=1
                and cp.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND d.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rr.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.ds_snpst_dt = DATE '2026-08-05'
                  AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2')
            ) x
        ) t
        WHERE rn = 1
    ) q
    WHERE chi_tieu IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch, category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
)

,VCSH as 
(
SELECT company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
		--sum (VCSH) VCSH
		VCSH
FROM (
	select company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		NVL(VCSH, TAI_SAN - NO_PT) AS VCSH,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1
	from (
		SELECT company_profile_id,
        	equity_ticker,
        	equity_listing_exch,
        	category_l1_id,
        	report_year,
        	report_quarter,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'TAI_SAN'		THEN data_value END) AS TAI_SAN,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'NO_PT'		THEN data_value END) AS NO_PT,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH'			THEN data_value END) AS VCSH
		FROM Chitiet_DN ct
		where report_quarter in (1,2,3,4,5)
			and TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd')  <= :report_date
			and chi_tieu in ('VCSH', 'TAI_SAN', 'NO_PT')
		GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch,
             category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
		)
	WHERE VCSH IS NOT NULL
   			OR (TAI_SAN IS NOT NULL AND NO_PT IS NOT NULL)
	)
WHERE rn1=1
)
,LNST4Q as 
(
	SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        --SUM(LNST) AS lnst_ttm
        SUM(data_value) AS lnst_ttm
	FROM (
        SELECT  company_profile_id,
                equity_ticker,
                equity_listing_exch,
                category_l1_id,
                report_year,
                report_quarter,
                chi_tieu, data_value,
                --LNST,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS rn_all,
                CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                       ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) END AS rn_q,
                FIRST_VALUE(report_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id
                                                  ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS q_latest,
                -- Số kỳ quý (1-4) công ty đang có
                COUNT(CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id) AS so_quy
        FROM    Chitiet_DN ct
        WHERE   report_quarter IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
        AND     TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= :report_date
        AND chi_tieu= 'LNST'
     ) t
	WHERE   (q_latest = 5  AND rn_all = 1)                   -- Kỳ gần nhất là năm -> lấy kỳ năm
	OR   (q_latest <> 5 AND rn_q <= 4 
--	AND so_quy >= 4				--phải đủ 4
	)    						-- Kỳ gần nhất là quý -> lấy 4 quý
--	and equity_ticker = 'AAA'
	GROUP BY
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id
)

			and chi_tieu in ('VCSH', 'TAI_SAN', 'NO_PT')
		GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch,
             category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
		)
	WHERE VCSH IS NOT NULL
   			OR (TAI_SAN IS NOT NULL AND NO_PT IS NOT NULL)
	)
WHERE rn1=1
)
,LNST4Q as 
(
	SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        --SUM(LNST) AS lnst_ttm
        SUM(data_value) AS lnst_ttm
	FROM (
        SELECT  company_profile_id,
                equity_ticker,
                equity_listing_exch,
                category_l1_id,
                report_year,
                report_quarter,
                chi_tieu, data_value,
                --LNST,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS rn_all,
                CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                       ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) END AS rn_q,
                FIRST_VALUE(report_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id
                                                  ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS q_latest,
                -- Số kỳ quý (1-4) công ty đang có
                COUNT(CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id) AS so_quy
        FROM    Chitiet_DN ct
        WHERE   report_quarter IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
        AND     TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= :report_date
        AND chi_tieu= 'LNST'
     ) t
	WHERE   (q_latest = 5  AND rn_all = 1)                   -- Kỳ gần nhất là năm -> lấy kỳ năm
	OR   (q_latest <> 5 AND rn_q <= 4 
--	AND so_quy >= 4				--phải đủ 4
	)    						-- Kỳ gần nhất là quý -> lấy 4 quý
--	and equity_ticker = 'AAA'
	GROUP BY
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id
)

,all_form_ids AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id, fr.REPORT_CODE
    FROM uat_scms_ods.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE IN ('BCTCHN', 'BCTCRL')
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
),
-- Quý gần nhất có dữ liệu <= ngày tra cứu (chỉ dùng cho Vốn CSH)
latest_quy AS (
    SELECT p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub ON CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING) = CAST(p.ID AS STRING)
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT null
      and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1
--      AND c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
      AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
    ORDER BY p.REPORT_YEAR DESC, p.PERIOD DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Latest submission (dùng chung cho cả 2 chỉ tiêu)
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (
              SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids WHERE REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
          )
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (
              SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids WHERE REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
          )
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
-- item_list: Vốn CSH
item_list_hn_vcsh AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCHN'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCTCH_06620'
      AND row_path LIKE '%VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU (400 = 410 + 420)%'  -- TS359
      AND column_path LIKE '%Số cuối năm%'
),
item_list_rl_vcsh AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCRL'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCTCR_06608'
      AND column_path LIKE '%Số cuối năm%'
      AND (
          row_path LIKE '%D. VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU%'      -- TS223
          OR row_path LIKE '%(400 = 410 + 420)%'   -- TS221
      )
),
-- item_list: Lợi nhuận sau thuế
item_list_hn_lnst AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCHN'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCKQHDHN_06622'   -- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG HỢP NHẤT
      AND row_path LIKE '%XI. LỢI NHUẬN KẾ TOÁN SAU THUẾ TNDN%'  -- TS121
      AND column_path LIKE '%Năm nay%'
),
item_list_rl_lnst AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCRL'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCKQHDR_06610'    -- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG RIÊNG
      AND row_path LIKE '%XI. LỢI NHUẬN KẾ TOÁN SAU THUẾ TNDN%'  -- TS119
      AND column_path LIKE '%Năm nay%'
),
-- item_value: Vốn CSH
item_value_hn_vcsh AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id, iv.value,
           CASE WHEN iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN TRY_CAST(iv.value AS decimal(38,10)) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_hn_vcsh)
),
item_value_rl_vcsh AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id, iv.value,
           CASE WHEN iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN TRY_CAST(iv.value AS decimal(38,10)) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_rl_vcsh)
),
-- item_value: Lợi nhuận sau thuế
item_value_hn_lnst AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id,
           CASE WHEN iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN TRY_CAST(iv.value AS decimal(38,10)) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_hn_lnst)
),
item_value_rl_lnst AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id,
           CASE WHEN iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN TRY_CAST(iv.value AS decimal(38,10)) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_rl_lnst)
),
-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN theo từng kỳ (dùng chung)
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
                    p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
),
-- Vốn CSH: chỉ quý gần nhất
ctck_data_vcsh AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn_vcsh iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%D. VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU%'
                            THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%(400 = 410 + 420)%'
                     THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_rl_vcsh iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    JOIN item_list_rl_vcsh il ON il.item_id = iv.item_id
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
),
-- LNST: tất cả các quý <= ngày tra cứu
ctck_data_lnst AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS lnst
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn_lnst iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS lnst
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_rl_lnst iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT d.sc_firm_info_id, d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD, d.lnst, d.loai_bc_nop,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.sc_firm_info_id
               ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR DESC, d.PERIOD DESC
           ) AS quy_rank
    FROM ctck_data_lnst d
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = d.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE 1=1
    and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1
	--c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
      AND d.lnst IS NOT NULL
),
-- Kết quả Vốn CSH theo CTCK
von_csh_ctck AS (
    SELECT
        c.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
        c.SECURITIES_CODE AS ma_ck,
        d.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bc_von_csh,
        CONCAT('Q', CAST(d.PERIOD AS STRING), '/', CAST(d.REPORT_YEAR AS STRING)) AS quy_du_lieu,
        d.von_csh  AS von_csh
    FROM ctck_data_vcsh d
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = d.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE 1=1
    and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1
--    and c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
),
-- Kết quả LNST 4 quý theo CTCK
lnst_ctck AS (
    SELECT
        c.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
        c.SECURITIES_CODE AS ma_ck,
        r.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bc_lnst,
        SUM(r.lnst) AS lnst_4_quy
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = r.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE r.quy_rank <= 4
    and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1
     -- AND c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
    GROUP BY c.NAME_VI, c.SECURITIES_CODE, r.loai_bc_nop
)
,LN_VCSH_CTCK as
(
SELECT
    COALESCE(v.ten_ctck, l.ten_ctck) AS ten_ctck,
    COALESCE(v.ma_ck, l.ma_ck)       AS ma_ck,
    v.loai_bc_von_csh,
    v.quy_du_lieu,
    v.von_csh,
    l.loai_bc_lnst,
    l.lnst_4_quy
FROM von_csh_ctck v
FULL OUTER JOIN lnst_ctck l ON v.ma_ck = l.ma_ck
ORDER BY ten_ctck, ma_ck
)
--select * from LN_VCSH_CTCK

Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        statement_cd,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) AS statement_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    cd.company_profile_id,
                    cd.report_year,
                    cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
                        WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
                    END,
                    cd.submission_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f
            ON f.id = cd.form_id
           AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
          AND cd.submission_date <= ts.den_ngay
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
              JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf
                  ON vf.id = vr.form_id
                 AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= ts.den_ngay
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Doanh thu theo từng kỳ BCTC */
Doanh_thu AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        doanh_thu,
        submission_date
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            cp.equity_ticker,
            cdc.report_year,
            cdc.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS doanh_thu,
            cdc.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '10')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '03')
          )
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
