,cal AS (
 select MIN(c.tradingdate  ) AS d_next
-- , MAX(case when c.tradingdate <= :report_date then c.tradingdate END ) d_cur
 from 
 (
  SELECT DISTINCT TO_DATE(h.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS tradingdate
  FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book h
  WHERE h.trade_date > DATE_FORMAT(:report_date, 'yyyyMMdd')
    AND h.trade_date <= DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(:report_date, 1), 'yyyyMMdd')
  UNION  
  SELECT DISTINCT m.tradingdate
  FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_marketinfor m
  WHERE m.tradingdate > :report_date AND m.tradingdate <= ADD_MONTHS(:report_date, 1)
  ) c
)
,Von_hoa as
(
    SELECT
        x.tradingdate,
        x.symbol,
        x.floorcode,
        x.stocktype,
        x.price,
        x.closeprice,
        x.reference,
        x.d_next,
        x.vwap,
        os.outstanding_shares AS kllh_cp,
        x.price * os.outstanding_shares AS von_hoa_cophieu
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.tradingdate,
            s.symbol,
            s.floorcode,
            s.stocktype,
            CASE
                WHEN s.floorcode = '04' THEN
                    CASE
                        -- Chưa có VWAP tại T+1: chưa tính vốn hóa
                        WHEN n.vwap IS NULL THEN NULL
                        -- VWAP = 0: lấy giá tham chiếu ngày T
                        ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(n.vwap, 0), s.reference)
                    END
                ELSE s.closeprice
            END AS price,
            s.closeprice,
            s.reference,
            k.d_next,
            n.vwap
        FROM stock_eod s
        CROSS JOIN cal k
        LEFT JOIN stock_eod n
            ON n.symbol = s.symbol
           AND n.tradingdate = k.d_next
        WHERE s.tradingdate = :report_date

,VCSH as 
(
SELECT company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
		--sum (VCSH) VCSH
		VCSH
FROM (
	select company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		NVL(VCSH, TAI_SAN - NO_PT) AS VCSH,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1
	from (
		SELECT company_profile_id,
        	equity_ticker,
        	equity_listing_exch,
        	category_l1_id,
        	report_year,
        	report_quarter,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'TAI_SAN'		THEN data_value END) AS TAI_SAN,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'NO_PT'		THEN data_value END) AS NO_PT,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH'			THEN data_value END) AS VCSH
		FROM Chitiet_DN ct
		where report_quarter in (1,2,3,4,5)
			and TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd')  <= :report_date
			and chi_tieu in ('VCSH', 'TAI_SAN', 'NO_PT')
		GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch,
             category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
		)
	WHERE VCSH IS NOT NULL
   			OR (TAI_SAN IS NOT NULL AND NO_PT IS NOT NULL)
	)
WHERE rn1=1
)
,LNST4Q as 
(
	SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,

        --SUM(LNST) AS lnst_ttm
        SUM(data_value) AS lnst_ttm

                equity_ticker,

                --LNST,

                CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)

        COALESCE(

                            THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%(400 = 410 + 420)%'

    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)

                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD

      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date

    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

      )
),

item_list_hn_lnst AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list

      AND row_path LIKE '%XI. LỢI NHUẬN KẾ TOÁN SAU THUẾ TNDN%'  -- TS121

),
item_list_rl_lnst AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCRL'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCKQHDR_06610'    -- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG RIÊNG
      AND row_path LIKE '%XI. LỢI NHUẬN KẾ TOÁN SAU THUẾ TNDN%'  -- TS119
      AND column_path LIKE '%Năm nay%'
),
-- item_value: Vốn CSH
item_value_hn_vcsh AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id, iv.value,
           CASE WHEN iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN TRY_CAST(iv.value AS decimal(38,10)) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_hn_vcsh)
),
item_value_rl_vcsh AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id, iv.value,
           CASE WHEN iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN TRY_CAST(iv.value AS decimal(38,10)) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_rl_vcsh)
),
-- item_value: Lợi nhuận sau thuế
item_value_hn_lnst AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id,
           CASE WHEN iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN TRY_CAST(iv.value AS decimal(38,10)) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_hn_lnst)
),
item_value_rl_lnst AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id,
           CASE WHEN iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN TRY_CAST(iv.value AS decimal(38,10)) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_rl_lnst)
),
-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN theo từng kỳ (dùng chung)
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
                    p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
),
-- Vốn CSH: chỉ quý gần nhất
ctck_data_vcsh AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn_vcsh iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%D. VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU%'
                            THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%(400 = 410 + 420)%'
                     THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_rl_vcsh iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    JOIN item_list_rl_vcsh il ON il.item_id = iv.item_id
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
),
-- LNST: tất cả các quý <= ngày tra cứu
ctck_data_lnst AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS lnst
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn_lnst iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS lnst
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_rl_lnst iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT d.sc_firm_info_id, d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD, d.lnst, d.loai_bc_nop,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.sc_firm_info_id
               ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR DESC, d.PERIOD DESC
           ) AS quy_rank
    FROM ctck_data_lnst d
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = d.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE 1=1
    and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1
	--c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
      AND d.lnst IS NOT NULL
),
-- Kết quả Vốn CSH theo CTCK
von_csh_ctck AS (
    SELECT
        c.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
        c.SECURITIES_CODE AS ma_ck,
        d.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bc_von_csh,
        CONCAT('Q', CAST(d.PERIOD AS STRING), '/', CAST(d.REPORT_YEAR AS STRING)) AS quy_du_lieu,
        d.von_csh  AS von_csh
    FROM ctck_data_vcsh d
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = d.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE 1=1
    and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1
--    and c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
),
-- Kết quả LNST 4 quý theo CTCK
lnst_ctck AS (
    SELECT
        c.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
        c.SECURITIES_CODE AS ma_ck,
        r.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bc_lnst,
        SUM(r.lnst) AS lnst_4_quy
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = r.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE r.quy_rank <= 4
    and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1
     -- AND c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
    GROUP BY c.NAME_VI, c.SECURITIES_CODE, r.loai_bc_nop
)
,LN_VCSH_CTCK as
(
SELECT
    COALESCE(v.ten_ctck, l.ten_ctck) AS ten_ctck,
    COALESCE(v.ma_ck, l.ma_ck)       AS ma_ck,
    v.loai_bc_von_csh,
    v.quy_du_lieu,
    v.von_csh,
    l.loai_bc_lnst,
    l.lnst_4_quy
FROM von_csh_ctck v
FULL OUTER JOIN lnst_ctck l ON v.ma_ck = l.ma_ck
ORDER BY ten_ctck, ma_ck
)
--select * from LN_VCSH_CTCK
select vh.von_hoa_cophieu
,ROUND(von_hoa_cophieu / NULLIF(LNST, 0), 2) AS pe
,ROUND(von_hoa_cophieu / NULLIF(vcsh, 0), 2) AS pb
,x.*
from Von_hoa vh 
left join 
(
      SELECT 'IDS'  AS period_tag,

      vcsh VCSH
      FROM LN_VCSH_IDS -- IDS
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'SCMS' AS period_tag,

      FROM LN_VCSH_CTCK a -- SCMS

-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
                    p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
),
ctck_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)

    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    JOIN item_value_rl iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    JOIN item_list_rl il ON il.item_id = iv.item_id
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)

                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD

      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
)

-- GT tự doanh ròng (HOSE + HNX)
 WITH tu_doanh AS (
  -- HOSE
  SELECT t.Symbol AS ma_ck, t.[Trade Date] AS ngay_gd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy - Client/House Classification Code]='30'
  THEN t.[Execution - Value] ELSE 0 END) AS gt_mua,

  THEN t.[Execution - Value] ELSE 0 END) AS gt_ban
  FROM TRADE_BOOK_HOSE t
  WHERE t.[Trade Date]=:ngay_gd AND t.[Market ID]='STO'
  GROUP BY t.Symbol, t.[Trade Date]
 
  UNION ALL
 
  -- HNX / UPCOM
  SELECT t.[Issue Code], t.[Trade date],
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Buy client/house classification]='30'
  THEN CAST(t.[Trade price] AS NUMERIC)
  * CAST(t.[Trade quantity] AS NUMERIC)
  ELSE 0 END) AS gt_mua,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.[Sell client/house classification]='30'
  THEN CAST(t.[Trade price] AS NUMERIC)
  * CAST(t.[Trade quantity] AS NUMERIC)
  ELSE 0 END) AS gt_ban
  FROM Trade_HNX t
  WHERE t.[Trade date]=:ngay_gd AND t.[Market ID] IN ('STX','UPX')
  GROUP BY t.[Issue Code], t.[Trade date]
 )

WITH
Tham_so AS (
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(:tu_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS tu_ngay,
        TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS den_ngay
    FROM DUAL
),
/* EOD từng mã; lấy snapshot cuối cùng trong ngày */
Gia_EOD AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        ngay_gd,
        gia_dong_cua,
		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.symbol,
            TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
			floorCode,
            s.closePrice AS gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.symbol, s.tradingdate
                ORDER BY s.INDEXTIME DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất trước ngày bắt đầu */
Gia_dau AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua AS gia_dau
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.ngay_gd DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Gia_EOD g
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE g.ngay_gd < ts.tu_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất tại hoặc trước ngày kết thúc */
Gia_cuoi AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua,
        ngay_gd AS ngay_gia_cuoi,
		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.gia_dong_cua,
            g.ngay_gd,
			g.floorCode,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.ngay_gd DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Gia_EOD g
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE g.ngay_gd <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* KLLH gần nhất có hiệu lực tại ngày kết thúc */
KLLH_asof AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.MCK AS symbol,
            t."Khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành"
                AS so_luong_cp_luu_hanh,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.MCK
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM "BM 1_Báo cáo về khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành" t
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE t.Loai_CK = 'Co phieu'
          AND TO_DATE(t."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
Von_hoa AS (
    SELECT
        gc.symbol,
        gc.gia_dong_cua AS gia_cuoi,
        k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh AS kllh,
        CASE
            WHEN gc.gia_dong_cua IS NOT NULL
             AND k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN gc.gia_dong_cua * k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
        END AS von_hoa
    FROM Gia_cuoi gc
    LEFT JOIN KLLH_asof k
        ON k.symbol = gc.symbol
),
Nganh AS (
    SELECT
        cp.equity_ticker,
        c.industry_name
    FROM gms_ids_uat.categories c
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
        ON cp.category_l1_id = c.id
    WHERE c.active_flg = 1
),
Chi_so_thi_truong AS
(
    SELECT 
        idx.Symbol AS symbol,
        m.MARKETCODE AS bo_chi_so_thi_truong
    FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
    JOIN JAD_MARKETINFOR m ON m.MARKETCODE = idx.INDEXCODE
    WHERE m.MARKETCODE IN ('HOSE','UPCOM','HNX')
),
Chi_so_nganh AS
(
    SELECT 
        idx.Symbol AS symbol,
        m.MARKETCODE AS bo_chi_so_nganh
    FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
    JOIN JAD_MARKETINFOR m ON m.MARKETCODE = idx.INDEXCODE
     WHERE m.MARKETCODE NOT IN ('HOSE','UPCOM','HNX')
)
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        submission_date
        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
			  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
				
          )
		  AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
		  AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
		  AND vr.LANGUAGE_CD = 'VI'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
--SELECT * FROM Company_data_chuan 
--WHERE 1=1 
--AND company_profile_id = '1591';
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2:
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy LNST trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Chỉ các kỳ thực sự có LNST mới tồn tại ở đây
   - Xếp thứ tự và lấy 4 kỳ LNST gần nhất
   ========================================================= */
LNST_4_ky AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn     
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cdc.company_profile_id,
                cp.equity_ticker,
                cdc.report_year,
                cdc.report_quarter,
                d.data_value AS lnst
                ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.company_profile_id, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY d.UPDATED_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, d.CREATED_DATE DESC
            ) AS rn1
            FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
               AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
               AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
               AND cdc.STATEMENT_CD = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD 
			JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
              AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
              AND (
                     ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'DN' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'BH' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21' )
              )
              /* kỳ phải thực sự có giá trị LNST */
              AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
--              AND cp.equity_ticker = 'HVN'
        ) x
        WHERE x.rn1 = 1
    )
    WHERE rn <= 4
),
lnst_ttm AS
(
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker symbol,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(lnst) END AS lnst_ttm
    FROM LNST_4_ky
    WHERE 1=1
--    AND equity_ticker = 'HVN'
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker
/* Một giá trị VCSH cho mỗi mã/kỳ */
),
VCSH_quy AS (
    SELECT
        equity_ticker symbol,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        vcsh,
        company_profile_id
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1   
        FROM 
        (
        SELECT
            cp.equity_ticker,
            d.report_year,
            d.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS vcsh,
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '400')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '500')
          )
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
)
WHERE rn1 = 1
    )
,Giao_dich_NN_goc AS (
    SELECT
        t.symbol,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.buy_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.execution_volume
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kl_mua,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.sell_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.execution_volume
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kl_ban,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.buy_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.execution_value
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS gt_mua,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.sell_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.execution_value
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS gt_ban
    FROM krx.trade_book_hose t
    CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
    WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
          BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
      AND t.market_id = 'STK'
    GROUP BY t.symbol

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        t."Issue Code" AS symbol,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.buy_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_quantity
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kl_mua,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.sell_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_quantity
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kl_ban,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.buy_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_value
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS gt_mua,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.sell_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_value
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS gt_ban
    FROM krx.trade_book_hnx t
    CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
    WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
          BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
      AND t.market_id IN ('STX', 'UPX')
    GROUP BY t."Issue Code"
),

NDTNN AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        SUM(kl_mua) AS kl_mua,
        SUM(kl_ban) AS kl_ban,
        SUM(kl_mua) - SUM(kl_ban) AS kl_rong,
        SUM(gt_mua) AS gt_mua,
        SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_ban,
        SUM(gt_mua) - SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_rong
    FROM Giao_dich_NN_goc
    GROUP BY symbol
),

Xep_hang_NDTNN AS (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN :loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' THEN nd.gt_rong
                END DESC NULLS LAST,

                CASE
                    WHEN :loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' THEN nd.gt_rong
                END ASC NULLS LAST,

                nd.symbol
        ) AS stt,

        nd.symbol AS ma,

        CASE
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '10' THEN 'HOSE'
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '02' THEN 'HNX'
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
            ELSE gc.floorcode
        END AS san,

        ng.industry_name AS nganh,
        gc.gia_dong_cua,
        gc.gia_dong_cua - gd.gia_dau AS thay_doi,

        ROUND(
            (gc.gia_dong_cua - gd.gia_dau)
            / NULLIF(gd.gia_dau, 0) * 100,
            2
        ) AS phan_tram_thay_doi,

        nd.kl_mua,
        nd.kl_ban,
        nd.kl_rong,
        nd.gt_mua,
        nd.gt_ban,
        nd.gt_rong,

        vh.von_hoa,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(lt.lnst_ttm, 0), 2) AS pe,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(vm.vcsh, 0), 2) AS pb
    FROM NDTNN nd
    LEFT JOIN Gia_cuoi gc
        ON gc.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Gia_dau gd
        ON gd.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Von_hoa vh
        ON vh.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Nganh ng
        ON ng.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN LNST_TTM lt
        ON lt.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN VCSH_moi_nhat vm
        ON vm.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    WHERE (:loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' AND nd.gt_rong > 0)
       OR (:loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' AND nd.gt_rong < 0)
)

SELECT
    stt,
    ma,
    san,
    nganh,
    gia_dong_cua,
    thay_doi,
    phan_tram_thay_doi,
    kl_mua,
    kl_ban,
    kl_rong,
    gt_mua,
    gt_ban,
    gt_rong,
    von_hoa,
    pe,
    pb
FROM Xep_hang_NDTNN
WHERE stt <= :top_n
ORDER BY stt;

-- Tổng 4 quý gần nhất có dữ liệu <= ngày tra cứu
WITH params AS (
    SELECT TO_DATE('2025-10-10') AS p_ngay  -- Thay ngày tra cứu
),
all_form_ids AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id, fr.REPORT_CODE
    FROM uat_scms_ods.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE IN ('BCTCHN', 'BCTCRL')
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
),
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (
              SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids WHERE REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
          )
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (
              SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids WHERE REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
          )
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
item_list_hn AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCHN'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCKQHDHN_06622'   -- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG HỢP NHẤT
      AND row_path LIKE '%XI. LỢI NHUẬN KẾ TOÁN SAU THUẾ TNDN%'  -- TS121
      AND column_path = 'Năm nay'
),
item_list_rl AS (
    SELECT item_id, row_path, column_path, row_order
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_list
    WHERE report_code = 'BCTCRL'
      AND sheet_name = 'BCKQHDR_06610'   -- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG RIÊNG
      AND row_path LIKE '%XI. LỢI NHUẬN KẾ TOÁN SAU THUẾ TNDN%'  -- TS119
      AND column_path = 'Năm nay'
),
item_value_hn AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id,
           CASE WHEN iv.data_type = 'number' AND iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN CAST(iv.value AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_hn)
),
item_value_rl AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id,
           CASE WHEN iv.data_type = 'number' AND iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN CAST(iv.value AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_rl)
),
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
                    p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
),
ctck_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS lnst
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS lnst
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_rl iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT d.sc_firm_info_id, d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD, d.lnst, d.loai_bc_nop,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.sc_firm_info_id
               ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR DESC, d.PERIOD DESC
           ) AS quy_rank
    FROM ctck_data d
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = d.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
      AND d.lnst IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    c.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
    c.SECURITIES_CODE AS ma_ck,
    r.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bao_cao,
    SUM(r.lnst) / 1000000000 AS lnst_4_quy
FROM ranked r
JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = r.sc_firm_info_id
WHERE r.quy_rank <= 4
  AND c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
GROUP BY c.NAME_VI, c.SECURITIES_CODE, r.loai_bc_nop
ORDER BY c.NAME_VI, c.SECURITIES_CODE;

WITH params AS (

all_form_ids AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id, fr.REPORT_CODE
    FROM uat_scms_ods.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE IN ('BCTCHN', 'BCTCRL')
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
),
-- Quý gần nhất có dữ liệu <= ngày tra cứu
latest_quy AS (
    SELECT p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub ON CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING) = CAST(p.ID AS STRING)
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      AND c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
      AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
    ORDER BY p.REPORT_YEAR DESC, p.PERIOD DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Latest submission của BCTCHN
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (
              SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids WHERE REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
          )
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
-- Latest submission của BCTCRL
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (
              SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids WHERE REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
          )
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
-- item_list filter theo sheet tương ứng
item_list_hn AS (

          row_path = 'D. VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU'          -- TS223
          OR row_path LIKE '%(400 = 410 + 420)%'  -- TS221
      )
),
-- item_value của BCTCHN
item_value_hn AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id, iv.value,
           CASE WHEN iv.data_type = 'number' AND iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN CAST(iv.value AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_hn)
),
-- item_value của BCTCRL
item_value_rl AS (
    SELECT iv.report_log_id, iv.item_id, iv.value,
           CASE WHEN iv.data_type = 'number' AND iv.value NOT IN ('[NULL]','','null')
                THEN CAST(iv.value AS DOUBLE) ELSE NULL END AS numeric_value
    FROM uat_scms_ods.item_value iv
    WHERE CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) IN (SELECT CAST(ID AS STRING) FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND iv.item_id IN (SELECT item_id FROM item_list_rl)
),
-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
                    p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
),
ctck_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path = 'D. VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU'
                                    THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
                    SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%(400 = 410 + 420)%'
                             THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                ) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_rl iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
    CROSS JOIN params pr
    JOIN item_list_rl il ON il.item_id = iv.item_id
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= pr.p_ngay
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
)
SELECT
    c.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
    c.SECURITIES_CODE AS ma_ck,
    d.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bao_cao,
    CONCAT('Q', CAST(d.PERIOD AS STRING), '/', CAST(d.REPORT_YEAR AS STRING)) AS quy_du_lieu,
    d.von_csh / 1000000000 AS von_csh
FROM ctck_data d
JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = d.sc_firm_info_id
WHERE c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD, c.NAME_VI, c.SECURITIES_CODE;

SELECT company_profile_id,

,LNST4Q as

                CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

with stock_eod as 
 (
 select * from 
 (
 select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.symbol,tradingdate ORDER BY s.tradingtime desc,s.`sequence` desc ) AS rn1
                        , s.*
                FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor s
                ) where rn1 =1 
                )  
,cal AS (
 select MIN(c.tradingdate  ) AS d_next
-- , MAX(case when c.tradingdate <= :report_date then c.tradingdate END ) d_cur
 from 
 (
  SELECT DISTINCT TO_DATE(h.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS tradingdate
  FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book h
  WHERE h.trade_date > DATE_FORMAT(:report_date, 'yyyyMMdd')
    AND h.trade_date <= DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(:report_date, 1), 'yyyyMMdd')
  UNION  
  SELECT DISTINCT m.tradingdate
  FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_marketinfor m
  WHERE m.tradingdate > :report_date AND m.tradingdate <= ADD_MONTHS(:report_date, 1)
  ) c
)
,Von_hoa as
(
    SELECT
        x.tradingdate,
        x.symbol,
        x.floorcode,
        x.stocktype,
        x.price,
        x.closeprice,
        x.reference,
        x.d_next,
        x.vwap,
        os.outstanding_shares AS kllh_cp,
        x.price * os.outstanding_shares AS von_hoa_cophieu
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.tradingdate,
            s.symbol,
            s.floorcode,
            s.stocktype,
            CASE
                WHEN s.floorcode = '04' THEN
                    CASE
                        -- Chưa có VWAP tại T+1: chưa tính vốn hóa
                        WHEN n.vwap IS NULL THEN NULL
                        -- VWAP = 0: lấy giá tham chiếu ngày T
                        ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(n.vwap, 0), s.reference)
                    END
                ELSE s.closeprice
            END AS price,
            s.closeprice,
            s.reference,
            k.d_next,
            n.vwap
        FROM stock_eod s

					ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

						ORDER BY (CASE WHEN cell_enabled_flg is null then 3 else cell_enabled_flg end) ASC,

					) AS rn
				FROM (
					SELECT
						cdc.company_profile_id,
						cp.equity_ticker,

						cp.category_l1_id,
						rc.enterprise_type_cd,

						cdc.report_quarter,
						rc.report_cd,
						cdc.form_tp,		cdc.submission_date,	d.cell_enabled_flg,	--20261112

						d.id AS data_id

					JOIN

							select cp.*

							from uat_ids_stg.company_profiles cp
							where cp.ds_snpst_dt = :Ngay_gd

					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.data d
					ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
					AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
					AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.report_catalog rc
					ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
					AND cdc.form_tp = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rrow rr
					ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
					AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
					JOIN UAT_IDS_STG.rcol rc2
					ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd
					AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
					WHERE 1=1
					and  cp.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and  d.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and rc.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and rr.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and  rc2.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					and rc2.ds_snpst_dt =  :Ngay_gd
					AND rc2.col_desc IN ('1','2')
					--and d.cell_enabled_flg is not null

				) x
			) t WHERE rn = 1

,VCSH as 
(
SELECT company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
		--sum (VCSH) VCSH
		VCSH
FROM (
	select company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		NVL(VCSH, TAI_SAN - NO_PT) AS VCSH,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1
	from (
		SELECT company_profile_id,
        	equity_ticker,
        	equity_listing_exch,
        	category_l1_id,
        	report_year,
        	report_quarter,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'TAI_SAN'		THEN data_value END) AS TAI_SAN,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'NO_PT'		THEN data_value END) AS NO_PT,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH'			THEN data_value END) AS VCSH
		FROM Chitiet_DN ct
		where report_quarter in (1,2,3,4,5)
			and TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd')  <= :report_date
			and chi_tieu in ('VCSH', 'TAI_SAN', 'NO_PT')
		GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch,
             category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
		)
	WHERE VCSH IS NOT NULL
   			OR (TAI_SAN IS NOT NULL AND NO_PT IS NOT NULL)
	)
WHERE rn1=1
)
,LNST4Q as 
(
	SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        --SUM(LNST) AS lnst_ttm
        SUM(data_value) AS lnst_ttm
	FROM (
        SELECT  company_profile_id,
                equity_ticker,
                equity_listing_exch,
                category_l1_id,
                report_year,
                report_quarter,
                chi_tieu, data_value,
                --LNST,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS rn_all,
                CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                       ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) END AS rn_q,
                FIRST_VALUE(report_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id
                                                  ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS q_latest,
                -- Số kỳ quý (1-4) công ty đang có
                COUNT(CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id) AS so_quy
        FROM    Chitiet_DN ct

        AND     TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= :report_date
        AND chi_tieu= 'LNST'
     ) t
	WHERE   (q_latest = 5  AND rn_all = 1)                   -- Kỳ gần nhất là năm -> lấy kỳ năm
	OR   (q_latest <> 5 AND rn_q <= 4 
--	AND so_quy >= 4				--phải đủ 4

	GROUP BY

        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id
)

        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,

    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)

    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    SELECT

        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
        COALESCE(

                            THEN iv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN il.row_path LIKE '%(400 = 410 + 420)%'

    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)

                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)

      AND p.REPORT_YEAR = (SELECT REPORT_YEAR FROM latest_quy)
      AND p.PERIOD = (SELECT PERIOD FROM latest_quy)
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_hn_lnst iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)

    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)

    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING) AS sc_firm_info_id,
        p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(iv.numeric_value) AS lnst
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON CAST(p.ID AS STRING) = CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING)
    JOIN item_value_rl_lnst iv ON CAST(iv.report_log_id AS STRING) = CAST(sub.ID AS STRING)
--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.sc_firm_info_id = CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING)
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
      AND hn.sc_firm_info_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CAST(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID AS STRING), p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT d.sc_firm_info_id, d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD, d.lnst, d.loai_bc_nop,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.sc_firm_info_id
               ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR DESC, d.PERIOD DESC
           ) AS quy_rank
    FROM ctck_data_lnst d
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = d.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE 1=1
    and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1
	--c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
      AND d.lnst IS NOT NULL
),
-- Kết quả Vốn CSH theo CTCK
von_csh_ctck AS (
    SELECT
        c.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
        c.SECURITIES_CODE AS ma_ck,
        d.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bc_von_csh,
        CONCAT('Q', CAST(d.PERIOD AS STRING), '/', CAST(d.REPORT_YEAR AS STRING)) AS quy_du_lieu,
        d.von_csh  AS von_csh
    FROM ctck_data_vcsh d
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = d.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE 1=1
    and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1
--    and c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
),
-- Kết quả LNST 4 quý theo CTCK
lnst_ctck AS (
    SELECT
        c.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
        c.SECURITIES_CODE AS ma_ck,
        r.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bc_lnst,
        SUM(r.lnst) AS lnst_4_quy
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN uat_scms_ods.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON CAST(c.ID AS STRING) = r.sc_firm_info_id
    WHERE r.quy_rank <= 4
    and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1
     -- AND c.SECURITIES_CODE IN ('BVS','MBS','SHS','VFS')
    GROUP BY c.NAME_VI, c.SECURITIES_CODE, r.loai_bc_nop
)
,LN_VCSH_CTCK as
(
SELECT
    COALESCE(v.ten_ctck, l.ten_ctck) AS ten_ctck,
    COALESCE(v.ma_ck, l.ma_ck)       AS ma_ck,
    v.loai_bc_von_csh,
    v.quy_du_lieu,
    v.von_csh,
    l.loai_bc_lnst,
    l.lnst_4_quy
FROM von_csh_ctck v
FULL OUTER JOIN lnst_ctck l ON v.ma_ck = l.ma_ck
ORDER BY ten_ctck, ma_ck
)
--select * from LN_VCSH_CTCK
select vh.von_hoa_cophieu
,ROUND(von_hoa_cophieu / NULLIF(LNST, 0), 2) AS pe
,ROUND(von_hoa_cophieu / NULLIF(vcsh, 0), 2) AS pb
,x.*
from Von_hoa vh 
left join 
(
      SELECT 'IDS'  AS period_tag, 
      equity_ticker Ma_CK,
      lnst_ttm LNST,
      vcsh VCSH
      FROM LN_VCSH_IDS -- IDS
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'SCMS' AS period_tag, 
      a.ma_ck,
      lnst_4_quy LNST,
      von_csh VCSH
      FROM LN_VCSH_CTCK a -- SCMS
      ) x on vh.symbol = x.Ma_CK

with stock_eod as 
 (
 select * from 
 (
 SELECT
			ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.symbol,tradingdate ORDER BY s.tradingtime desc,s.`sequence` desc ) AS rn1
			, s.*
		FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor s
		)
		where rn1 =1 
--		where s.tradingdate = '2026-08-28'
		)  
,
 cal AS (
 select MIN(c.tradingdate  ) AS d_next
-- , MAX(case when c.tradingdate <= :report_date then c.tradingdate END ) d_cur
 from 
 (
  SELECT DISTINCT TO_DATE(h.trade_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS tradingdate
  FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book h
  WHERE h.trade_date > DATE_FORMAT(:report_date, 'yyyyMMdd')
    AND h.trade_date <= DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(:report_date, 1), 'yyyyMMdd')
  UNION  
  SELECT DISTINCT m.tradingdate
  FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_marketinfor m
  WHERE m.tradingdate > :report_date AND m.tradingdate <= ADD_MONTHS(:report_date, 1)
  ) c
)
    SELECT
        x.tradingdate,
        x.symbol,
        x.floorcode,
        x.stocktype,
        x.price,
        x.closeprice,
        x.reference,
        x.d_next,
        x.vwap,
        os.outstanding_shares AS kllh_cp,
        x.price * os.outstanding_shares AS von_hoa_cophieu
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.tradingdate,
            s.symbol,
            s.floorcode,
            s.stocktype,
            CASE
                WHEN s.floorcode = '04' THEN
                    CASE
                        -- Chưa có VWAP tại T+1: chưa tính vốn hóa
                        WHEN n.vwap IS NULL THEN NULL
                        -- VWAP = 0: lấy giá tham chiếu ngày T
                        ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(n.vwap, 0), s.reference)
                    END
                ELSE s.closeprice
            END AS price,
            s.closeprice,
            s.reference,
            k.d_next,
            n.vwap
        FROM stock_eod s
        CROSS JOIN cal k
        LEFT JOIN stock_eod n
            ON n.symbol = s.symbol
           AND n.tradingdate = k.d_next
        WHERE s.tradingdate = '2026-08-28'
--          AND s.floorcode IN ('02', '04', '10')
--          AND s.stocktype = '2' -- Cổ phiếu
    ) x
LEFT JOIN 
    (
        select
        	t.ticker_symbol,
            TO_DATE(t.transaction_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS transaction_date,
            t.outstanding_shares,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.ticker_symbol
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t.transaction_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM  uat_vsdc_stg.outstanding_shares t
           Where TO_DATE(t.transaction_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= :report_date
    ) os ON os.transaction_date = x.tradingdate AND os.ticker_symbol = x.symbol and os.rn = 1
       where symbol = 'ADC'

WITH
Tham_so AS (
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(:tu_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS tu_ngay,
        TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD') AS den_ngay
    FROM DUAL
),
/* EOD từng mã; lấy snapshot cuối cùng trong ngày */
Gia_EOD AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        ngay_gd,
        gia_dong_cua,
		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.symbol,
            TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS ngay_gd,
			floorCode,
            s.closePrice AS gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.symbol, s.tradingdate
                ORDER BY s.INDEXTIME DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM JAD_STOCKINFOR s
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE TO_DATE(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất trước ngày bắt đầu */
Gia_dau AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua AS gia_dau
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.gia_dong_cua,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.ngay_gd DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Gia_EOD g
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE g.ngay_gd < ts.tu_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* Giá đóng cửa phiên gần nhất tại hoặc trước ngày kết thúc */
Gia_cuoi AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        gia_dong_cua,
        ngay_gd AS ngay_gia_cuoi,
		floorCode
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.symbol,
            g.gia_dong_cua,
            g.ngay_gd,
			g.floorCode,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY g.symbol
                ORDER BY g.ngay_gd DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Gia_EOD g
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE g.ngay_gd <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
/* KLLH gần nhất có hiệu lực tại ngày kết thúc */
KLLH_asof AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t.MCK AS symbol,
            t."Khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành"
                AS so_luong_cp_luu_hanh,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.MCK
                ORDER BY TO_DATE(t."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM "BM 1_Báo cáo về khối lượng chứng khoán đang lưu hành" t
        CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
        WHERE t.Loai_CK = 'Co phieu'
          AND TO_DATE(t."Ngày báo cáo", 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ts.den_ngay
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
Von_hoa AS (
    SELECT
        gc.symbol,
        gc.gia_dong_cua AS gia_cuoi,
        k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh AS kllh,
        CASE
            WHEN gc.gia_dong_cua IS NOT NULL
             AND k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN gc.gia_dong_cua * k.so_luong_cp_luu_hanh
        END AS von_hoa
    FROM Gia_cuoi gc
    LEFT JOIN KLLH_asof k
        ON k.symbol = gc.symbol
),
Nganh AS (
    SELECT
        cp.equity_ticker,
        c.industry_name
    FROM gms_ids_uat.categories c
    JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
        ON cp.category_l1_id = c.id
    WHERE c.active_flg = 1
),
Chi_so_thi_truong AS
(
    SELECT 
        idx.Symbol AS symbol,
        m.MARKETCODE AS bo_chi_so_thi_truong
    FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
    JOIN JAD_MARKETINFOR m ON m.MARKETCODE = idx.INDEXCODE
    WHERE m.MARKETCODE IN ('HOSE','UPCOM','HNX')
),
Chi_so_nganh AS
(
    SELECT 
        idx.Symbol AS symbol,
        m.MARKETCODE AS bo_chi_so_nganh
    FROM JAD_CSIDXINFOR idx
    JOIN JAD_MARKETINFOR m ON m.MARKETCODE = idx.INDEXCODE
     WHERE m.MARKETCODE NOT IN ('HOSE','UPCOM','HNX')
)
/* BƯỚC 1:
   Xác định đúng 1 company_data cho mỗi NNT + kỳ:
   - Kỳ phải tồn tại trong violation_report với base_date <= :den_ngay
   - company_data phải APPROVED
   - Chỉ lấy HN/TH/ME/RI
   - Ưu tiên loại báo cáo: HN -> TH -> ME -> RI
   - Trong cùng loại báo cáo: lấy submission_date mới nhất
*/
Company_data_chuan AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        company_data_id,
        form_cd,
        submission_date
        ,SUBSTR(form_cd,1,2) STATEMENT_CD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cd.company_profile_id,
            cd.report_year,
            cd.report_quarter,
            cd.id AS company_data_id,
            f.form_cd,
            cd.submission_date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.company_profile_id, cd.report_year, cd.report_quarter
                ORDER BY CASE 	WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'HN%' THEN 1
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'TH%' THEN 2
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'ME%' THEN 3
								WHEN f.form_cd LIKE 'RI%' THEN 4
							END, cd.submission_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM gms_ids_uat.company_data cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms f ON f.id = cd.form_id AND f.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
        WHERE cd.news_status_cd = 'APPROVED'
          AND f.form_cd LIKE '%QUAR'
          AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM gms_ids_uat.violation_report vr
			  JOIN gms_ids_uat.forms vf ON vf.id = vr.form_id AND vf.news_type_cd = 'DINH_KY'
              WHERE vr.company_profile_id = cd.company_profile_id
                AND vr.period_year = cd.report_year
                AND vr.period_quarter = cd.report_quarter
                AND vr.base_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
				
          )
		  AND SUBSTR(f.form_cd, 1, 2) IN ('HN', 'TH', 'ME', 'RI')
		  AND cd.submission_date <= TO_DATE(:den_ngay, 'YYYYMMDD')
		  AND vr.LANGUAGE_CD = 'VI'
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
--SELECT * FROM Company_data_chuan 
--WHERE 1=1 
--AND company_profile_id = '1591';
/* =========================================================
   BƯỚC 2:
   - Từ các kỳ hợp lệ ở trên, lấy LNST trong DATA
   - DATA join bằng: company_profile_id + report_year + report_quarter
   - Chỉ các kỳ thực sự có LNST mới tồn tại ở đây
   - Xếp thứ tự và lấy 4 kỳ LNST gần nhất
   ========================================================= */
LNST_4_ky AS (
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        lnst
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn     
        FROM (
            SELECT
                cdc.company_profile_id,
                cp.equity_ticker,
                cdc.report_year,
                cdc.report_quarter,
                d.data_value AS lnst
                ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY d.company_profile_id, d.report_year, d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY d.UPDATED_DATE DESC NULLS LAST, d.CREATED_DATE DESC
            ) AS rn1
            FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
               AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
               AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
               AND cdc.STATEMENT_CD = rc.FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_CD 
			JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rc2 ON rc2.col_cd = d.col_cd AND rc2.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
            WHERE rc2.col_desc = '1'
              AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCKQKD%'
              AND (
                     ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'DN' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'BH' AND rr.row_desc = '60' )
                  OR ( UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD' AND rr.row_desc = '21' )
              )
              /* kỳ phải thực sự có giá trị LNST */
              AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
--              AND cp.equity_ticker = 'HVN'
        ) x
        WHERE x.rn1 = 1
    )
    WHERE rn <= 4
),
lnst_ttm AS
(
    SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker symbol,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(lnst) END AS lnst_ttm
    FROM LNST_4_ky
    WHERE 1=1
--    AND equity_ticker = 'HVN'
    GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker
/* Một giá trị VCSH cho mỗi mã/kỳ */
),
VCSH_quy AS (
    SELECT
        equity_ticker symbol,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
        vcsh,
        company_profile_id
    FROM (
        SELECT x.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY x.company_profile_id ORDER BY x.report_year DESC, x.report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1   
        FROM 
        (
        SELECT
            cp.equity_ticker,
            d.report_year,
            d.report_quarter,
            d.data_value AS vcsh,
            cdc.company_profile_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.company_profile_id,
                    d.report_year,
                    d.report_quarter
                ORDER BY
                    d.updated_date DESC NULLS LAST,
                    d.created_date DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM Company_data_chuan cdc
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.company_profiles cp
            ON cp.id = cdc.company_profile_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.data d
            ON d.company_profile_id = cdc.company_profile_id
           AND d.report_year = cdc.report_year
           AND d.report_quarter = cdc.report_quarter
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.report_catalog rc
            ON rc.id = d.report_catalog_id
           AND rc.financial_statement_cd = cdc.statement_cd
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rrow rr
            ON rr.row_cd = d.row_cd
           AND rr.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        JOIN gms_ids_uat.rcol rcol
            ON rcol.col_cd = d.col_cd
           AND rcol.report_catalog_id = d.report_catalog_id
        WHERE rcol.col_desc = '1'
          AND rc.report_cd LIKE 'BCDKT%'
          AND d.data_value IS NOT NULL
          AND (
              (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) IN ('DN', 'BH')
               AND rr.row_desc = '400')
              OR (UPPER(rc.enterprise_type_cd) = 'TD'
                  AND rr.row_desc = '500')
          )
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
)
WHERE rn1 = 1
    )
,Giao_dich_NN_goc AS (
    SELECT
        t.symbol,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.buy_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.execution_volume
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kl_mua,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.sell_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.execution_volume
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kl_ban,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.buy_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.execution_value
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS gt_mua,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.sell_foreigner_investor_type IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.execution_value
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS gt_ban
    FROM krx.trade_book_hose t
    CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
    WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
          BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
      AND t.market_id = 'STK'
    GROUP BY t.symbol

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        t."Issue Code" AS symbol,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.buy_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_quantity
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kl_mua,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.sell_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_quantity
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kl_ban,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.buy_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_value
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS gt_mua,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN t.sell_foreign_investor_type_code IN ('10', '20')
                THEN t.trade_value
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS gt_ban
    FROM krx.trade_book_hnx t
    CROSS JOIN Tham_so ts
    WHERE TO_DATE(t.trade_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
          BETWEEN ts.tu_ngay AND ts.den_ngay
      AND t.market_id IN ('STX', 'UPX')
    GROUP BY t."Issue Code"
),

NDTNN AS (
    SELECT
        symbol,
        SUM(kl_mua) AS kl_mua,
        SUM(kl_ban) AS kl_ban,
        SUM(kl_mua) - SUM(kl_ban) AS kl_rong,
        SUM(gt_mua) AS gt_mua,
        SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_ban,
        SUM(gt_mua) - SUM(gt_ban) AS gt_rong
    FROM Giao_dich_NN_goc
    GROUP BY symbol
),

Xep_hang_NDTNN AS (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN :loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' THEN nd.gt_rong
                END DESC NULLS LAST,

                CASE
                    WHEN :loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' THEN nd.gt_rong
                END ASC NULLS LAST,

                nd.symbol
        ) AS stt,

        nd.symbol AS ma,

        CASE
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '10' THEN 'HOSE'
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '02' THEN 'HNX'
            WHEN gc.floorcode = '04' THEN 'UPCOM'
            ELSE gc.floorcode
        END AS san,

        ng.industry_name AS nganh,
        gc.gia_dong_cua,
        gc.gia_dong_cua - gd.gia_dau AS thay_doi,

        ROUND(
            (gc.gia_dong_cua - gd.gia_dau)
            / NULLIF(gd.gia_dau, 0) * 100,
            2
        ) AS phan_tram_thay_doi,

        nd.kl_mua,
        nd.kl_ban,
        nd.kl_rong,
        nd.gt_mua,
        nd.gt_ban,
        nd.gt_rong,

        vh.von_hoa,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(lt.lnst_ttm, 0), 2) AS pe,
        ROUND(vh.von_hoa / NULLIF(vm.vcsh, 0), 2) AS pb
    FROM NDTNN nd
    LEFT JOIN Gia_cuoi gc
        ON gc.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Gia_dau gd
        ON gd.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Von_hoa vh
        ON vh.symbol = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN Nganh ng
        ON ng.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN LNST_TTM lt
        ON lt.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    LEFT JOIN VCSH_moi_nhat vm
        ON vm.equity_ticker = nd.symbol
    WHERE (:loai_top = 'MUA_RONG' AND nd.gt_rong > 0)
       OR (:loai_top = 'BAN_RONG' AND nd.gt_rong < 0)
)

SELECT
    stt,
    ma,
    san,
    nganh,
    gia_dong_cua,
    thay_doi,
    phan_tram_thay_doi,
    kl_mua,
    kl_ban,
    kl_rong,
    gt_mua,
    gt_ban,
    gt_rong,
    von_hoa,
    pe,
    pb
FROM Xep_hang_NDTNN
WHERE stt <= :top_n
ORDER BY stt;

    SELECT
        x.tradingdate,
        x.symbol,

        x.d_next,

    FROM (

            s.reference,

,VCSH as 
(
SELECT company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
		--sum (VCSH) VCSH
		VCSH
FROM (
	select company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        report_year,
        report_quarter,
		NVL(VCSH, TAI_SAN - NO_PT) AS VCSH,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC ) AS rn1
	from (
		SELECT company_profile_id,
        	equity_ticker,
        	equity_listing_exch,
        	category_l1_id,
        	report_year,
        	report_quarter,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'TAI_SAN'		THEN data_value END) AS TAI_SAN,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'NO_PT'		THEN data_value END) AS NO_PT,
        	SUM(CASE WHEN chi_tieu = 'VCSH'			THEN data_value END) AS VCSH
		FROM Chitiet_DN ct
		where report_quarter in (1,2,3,4,5)
			and TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd')  <= :report_date
			and chi_tieu in ('VCSH', 'TAI_SAN', 'NO_PT')
		GROUP BY company_profile_id, equity_ticker, equity_listing_exch,
             category_l1_id, report_year, report_quarter
		)
	WHERE VCSH IS NOT NULL
   			OR (TAI_SAN IS NOT NULL AND NO_PT IS NOT NULL)
	)
WHERE rn1=1
)
,LNST4Q as 
(
	SELECT
        company_profile_id,
        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id,
        --SUM(LNST) AS lnst_ttm
        SUM(data_value) AS lnst_ttm
	FROM (
        SELECT  company_profile_id,
                equity_ticker,
                equity_listing_exch,
                category_l1_id,
                report_year,
                report_quarter,
                chi_tieu, data_value,
                --LNST,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS rn_all,
                CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id, CASE WHEN report_quarter = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                                       ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) END AS rn_q,
                FIRST_VALUE(report_quarter) OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id
                                                  ORDER BY report_year DESC, report_quarter DESC) AS q_latest,
                -- Số kỳ quý (1-4) công ty đang có
                COUNT(CASE WHEN report_quarter <> 5 THEN 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY company_profile_id) AS so_quy
        FROM    Chitiet_DN ct
        WHERE   report_quarter IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
        AND     TO_DATE(Ngay_ket_thuc, 'yyyy-MM-dd') <= :report_date
        AND chi_tieu= 'LNST'
     ) t
	WHERE   (q_latest = 5  AND rn_all = 1)                   -- Kỳ gần nhất là năm -> lấy kỳ năm
	OR   (q_latest <> 5 AND rn_q <= 4 
--	AND so_quy >= 4				--phải đủ 4
	)    						-- Kỳ gần nhất là quý -> lấy 4 quý
--	and equity_ticker = 'AAA'
	GROUP BY

        equity_ticker,
        equity_listing_exch,
        category_l1_id
)

-- Quý gần nhất có dữ liệu <= ngày tra cứu (chỉ dùng cho Vốn CSH)
latest_quy AS (
    SELECT p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    JOIN uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub ON CAST(sub.REF_ID AS STRING) = CAST(p.ID AS STRING)

--    CROSS JOIN params pr
    WHERE p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'

      and c.PUBLIC_COMPANY = 1

      AND TO_DATE(p.END_DATE) <= :report_date
    ORDER BY p.REPORT_YEAR DESC, p.PERIOD DESC

-- Latest submission (dùng chung cho cả 2 chỉ tiêu)
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub

              SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids WHERE REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
          )
    ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM uat_scms_ods.report_input_submission sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(sub.FORM_REPORT_ID AS STRING) IN (
              SELECT CAST(form_report_id AS STRING) FROM all_form_ids WHERE REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
          )
